jobs.excerpt: About VyssorVyssor is a Dubai based corporate services firm helping founders and companies set up and operate in the UAE.
jobs.description:
About Vyssor

Vyssor is a Dubai based corporate services firm helping founders and companies set up and operate in the UAE. We support clients across incorporation, visas, and ongoing financial compliance, with accounting as a core service line.

We are founder led, service driven, and remote first. Our reputation is built on accuracy, clear documentation, and hitting every deadline. We operate at pace, with a lean team, clear ownership, and high trust.

About the role

The Accounting Operations Lead owns the delivery and quality of bookkeeping and accounting compliance for Vyssor and its clients. This role ensures records are accurate, complete, and audit ready. It also ensures VAT and Corporate Tax obligations are met on time, every time.

This is not a transactional finance role only. It is a compliance execution and control role. You will enforce standards, lead the accounting team, and prevent problems before they hit deadlines.

Reporting line: CEO

Scope: Client bookkeeping oversight, VAT and Corporate Tax filings, internal accounting compliance, team leadership, process control, tooling and visibility.

About you

You are structured, deadline obsessed in a healthy way, and allergic to messy books. You know how UAE compliance works in the real world, not just in theory. You lead through clear standards, tight follow up, and calm execution.

You can manage a portfolio, manage a team, and manage risk. You communicate clearly with founders and non finance stakeholders, without turning it into a lecture. You protect scope, protect quality, and protect the business from compliance surprises.

Top 5 objectives:

  1. Bring full visibility to all client and internal compliance deadlines: Create or clean a single source of truth for VAT and Corporate Tax calendars, filings, and dependencies.

  2. Raise bookkeeping quality to audit ready standards across the portfolio: Implement review routines, checklists, and minimum documentation standards. Eliminate recurring errors.

  3. Stabilize VAT and Corporate Tax execution: Ensure every filing is prepared, reviewed, and submitted on time. Build a repeatable workflow with clear handoffs.

  4. Standardize client dossiers and SOPs: Create consistent folder structures, naming conventions, audit trails, and SOPs across client types and free zones.

  5. Improve team execution speed without quality loss: Clarify roles, priorities, and escalation paths. Coach the team. Build accountability and reduce bottlenecks.

Other responsibilities:

Client bookkeeping and compliance delivery

  • Oversee and review bookkeeping for client entities based on client provided documentation

  • Ensure compliance with UAE accounting standards, VAT requirements, and Corporate Tax obligations

  • Prepare, review, and submit VAT returns and Corporate Tax filings

  • Ensure records are complete, consistent, and audit ready

  • Act as escalation point for complex cases and technical questions

  • Ensure delivery stays within the agreed service scope. Flag scope creep early

Deadline and regulatory management

  • Own filing calendars, trackers, and status reporting

  • Proactively identify risks related to missing data, delays, or regulatory changes

  • Escalate compliance risks to management before deadlines are impacted

  • Maintain internal discipline around cutoffs and client input timelines

Internal accounting. Vyssor entities

  • Oversee bookkeeping and compliance for Vyssor internal entities

  • Coordinate AP and AR processes to ensure accurate reflection in the books

  • Prepare internal accounting summaries for management review

  • Apply the same standards internally as we apply to clients

Process and quality control

  • Own SOPs, checklists, and internal accounting guidelines

  • Maintain structured client dossiers, documentation trails, and audit evidence

  • Standardize workflows across different free zones and client categories

  • Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements. Automate where sensible

Team leadership and oversight

  • Lead and supervise the accounting team responsible for bookkeeping and filings

  • Assign, prioritize, and review work for accuracy, completeness, and deadlines

  • Support onboarding and training. Set clear expectations and standards

  • Drive accountability through consistent review cadence and performance feedback

Systems, CRM, and tools

  • Ensure consistent use of accounting software and CRM tracking

  • Preferably Zoho, but equivalent systems are fine if you can adapt quickly

  • Maintain visibility over client status, missing requirements, and upcoming filings

  • Collaborate with operations or systems support to improve workflows and automation

Client interaction when needed

  • Join client calls when senior accounting expertise is required

  • Support the team in sensitive compliance discussions

  • Explain bookkeeping, VAT, and Corporate Tax topics clearly to non finance stakeholders

Main requirements:

  • Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping oversight and compliance delivery

  • Strong working knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax filing requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and reliable deadline management

  • Experience working with accounting software, CRM tools, and structured documentation

  • Strong written and verbal English

  • Comfortable working in a service driven environment with clear scope boundaries

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in an accounting firm, corporate services provider, or multi entity client environment

  • Experience leading teams and setting operating rhythms

  • Familiarity with Zoho ecosystems: CRM, Books, analytics, automation

  • Audit preparation experience and strong documentation discipline

What success looks like

  • No missed deadlines. No surprises

  • Clean files. Clear audit trails. Consistent client dossiers

  • A team that executes with structure and confidence

  • Leadership can see the full portfolio status at a glance

  • Clients experience Vyssor as organized, responsive, and reliable

jobs.excerpt: Does the ESL grind feel like you're just filling seats?
jobs.description:
Does the ESL grind feel like you're just filling seats?

You love teaching English. You're good at it. But somewhere between the back-to-back group classes, the unpredictable schedules, and the lack of real student connection, it stopped feeling like teaching and started feeling like crowd management.

What if you could teach one student at a time — someone who actually booked you, actually shows up, and actually wants to learn?

Here Is Your Solution

The Really Great Teacher Company is looking for a passionate, professional South African ESL teacher to deliver one-on-one conversational and assessment-based English lessons to adult Japanese students. This is a structured, fully remote role with a real platform behind it — and students who choose to come back to you.

Position Details

  • Start Date: As soon as the recruitment process is concluded
  • Location: Remote - work-from-home
  • Students: Adult Japanese learners (all proficiency levels, beginner to advanced)
  • Format: One-on-one, 25-minute conversational and assessment-based classes
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Rate: $6.50 USD per hour
  • Contract Type: Independent contractor agreement with The Really Great Teacher Company
  • Schedule: Assigned shift; 5-minute break between consecutive classes
  • Additional Classes: Option to cover classes for absent teachers
  • Student Booking: Students book one class at a time; regular students possible if they enjoy your teaching

Requirements

  • 3-year National Diploma (minimum qualification)
  • Completed, accredited 120-hour TEFL certificate or equivalent
  • Minimum 1 year of ESL teaching experience
  • Demo lesson required as part of the application process
  • Able to teach English across all CEFR proficiency levels — from absolute beginner to advanced
  • Energetic, student-focused, and comfortable teaching online
  • Schedule-aware and responsive: you are responsible for knowing your shift and adapting to changes

Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Clear and effective communication
  • Patience and empathy with learners at all levels
  • Positive attitude and professional presence
  • Strong time management and organisational skills
  • Adaptability in a dynamic, student-driven environment
  • Problem-solving mindset

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Processor minimum 2GHz / 4 CPU; RAM minimum 8GB
  • Internet: Fibre connection with LAN cable; minimum 20 Mbps upload and download speed
  • Backup power: Required (load shedding/power outage preparedness)
  • Webcam and noise-cancelling headset
  • Quiet, private, well-lit teaching space with a neutral background

For more information, view our online ESL teacher's tech checklist.

Benefits

  1. Earn in USD: Your rate is $6.50 USD per hour — paid in a stable international currency, straight to you as an independent contractor.
  2. Real One-on-One Teaching: No group classes. Every session is 25 minutes with a single adult student. You'll adapt to their level — from absolute beginner to very advanced — and actually see the impact of your teaching.
  3. Teach Into a Market That Values Education: Japanese adult learners are motivated, respectful, and genuinely invested in improving their English. If they like you, they come back — meaning you can build a loyal, consistent student base over time.
  4. Minimal Admin — No Report Writing Required: The client uses AI to generate detailed student reports. Your only contribution is a brief, encouraging message — around 2 minutes of your time per class. That's it.
  5. Everything You Need Is Provided: Lesson materials are fully provided. You teach on the client's internal platform (linked to Zoom) — no lesson planning from scratch, no hunting for resources.

jobs.title: Senior Database Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About linqd.  We power growth for some of the biggest names in the building products industry, helping them connect with more customers, expand market share, and achieve measurable results.
jobs.description:
About linqd.

We power growth for some of the biggest names in the building products industry, helping them connect with more customers, expand market share, and achieve measurable results.

We’re a 100% virtual organization built on relationships, accountability, and performance. We invest in our people with competitive compensation, healthcare options, continuous learning, and a supportive, performance-driven culture, because the work we do for our clients is only as strong as the team behind it.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Database Analyst to take ownership of two distinct sides of our data infrastructure:

  • Stabilize and optimize our legacy SQL Server environment ('DMP'). Three Microsoft SQL Server instances, managed through Azure, hosting isolated per-client databases for our existing customer base. These servers need a clear-eyed operator to bring them back to health, fix accumulated performance issues, and keep them running reliably for the next several years while we transition workloads off them. These servers are also used for integrations with tools like Tableau, and through Azure functions, are responsible for syncing data to and from CRMs.
  • Design the database layer for our modern platform. Greenfield architecture on AWS using PostgreSQL for transactional workloads and ClickHouse for analytical / OLAP workloads. You will work alongside our senior services architect to facilitate the implementation of a new structure for a long-term platform to eventually replace DMP in a modernized stack using ClickHouse, AWS, and Postgres.

What You'll Do

Legacy DMP Environment (Microsoft SQL Server / Azure)

  • Audit the current state of the three DMP servers and produce a prioritized remediation plan for performance, stability, and maintainability.
  • Diagnose and resolve accumulated issues: index bloat, missing/redundant indexes, parameter sniffing, lock contention, fragmented statistics, runaway jobs, and storage pressure.
  • Enhance monitoring, baselining, and alerting on resource utilization, query performance, and job health through SolarWinds.
  • Lead the rollout of Airflow on DMP to replace existing scheduling/orchestration that has caused us issues (e.g., lock contention from a SQL Server-based meta-scheduler).
  • Manage the multi-tenant isolation model across per-client databases — backups, restores, capacity planning, and security.
  • Keep DMP healthy for several years of continued production use while modern workloads migrate off it incrementally.

Modern Platform (PostgreSQL + ClickHouse on AWS)

  • Work with our senior services Architect on our multi-phase long-term platform implementation. Translating application and business requirements into scalable and well-thought-out Clickhouse structures (multi-tenant).
  • Design PostgreSQL schemas for transactional workloads, with appropriate indexing, partitioning, and extension usage.
  • With work, senior services architect to build out ingestion processes for high-volume data, batch, and streaming with idempotency, backfill capability, and clean separation between raw, staged, and serving layers.
  • Model data for read performance: denormalized read models, aggregation tables, and pre-computed projections that keep dashboards and APIs fast as data volumes grow.
  • Define the operational practices for the new stack: monitoring, alerting, deployment, schema migration, and capacity planning.

Cross-Cutting

  • Optimize queries and indexes through systematic analysis, execution plans, wait stats, and query logs.
  • Guide backend and data engineers on writing database-friendly code and avoiding common anti-patterns.
  • Lead incident response for database-related issues across both environments and convert postmortems into durable improvements.
  • Make use of our internal AI/LLM tooling for database analysis, where it speeds up the work; we've built tooling specifically to assist with this kind of investigation.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional database analysis and engineering experience with significant ownership of production systems at scale.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, deep expertise: query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, partitioning, T-SQL, statistics, locking/blocking, isolation levels, and HA configurations. You should be comfortable diving into a neglected SQL Server environment and knowing exactly where to look.
  • PostgreSQL, strong working knowledge: query planning, indexes (B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN), MVCC, vacuum/auto vacuum tuning, partitioning, and relevant extensions.
  • Columnar / OLAP database experience, production experience with at least one columnar engine. ClickHouse strongly preferred; substantial experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, or Pinot is acceptable, provided you understand columnar storage internals (compression, sort keys, merge/compaction behavior) and can ramp on ClickHouse quickly.
  • Cloud experience across both Azure and AWS, Azure for the legacy DMP environment (Azure-managed SQL Server, monitoring, networking, identity), AWS for the modern stack (RDS / Aurora Postgres, networking, IAM, observability).
  • Big data instincts — track record designing and operating systems that scale into the billions of rows, with judgment on when to throw hardware at a problem versus re-architect.
  • Strong SQL fundamentals across dialects, including window functions, CTEs, and the ability to read and reason about execution plans across engines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Airflow experience, particularly migrating workloads onto it from existing scheduling systems.
  • Python for tooling, automation, and data work. (We do not expect C# proficiency.)
  • Docker for local development and deployment.
  • Familiarity with Railway is preferred; otherwise, a strong willingness to learn is required, as it is our primary platform for modern infrastructure deployment.
  • SolarWinds experience for database monitoring.
  • Tableau familiarity and the data modeling considerations that make BI tools perform well against analytical backends.
  • Familiarity with Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or open table formats/lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience with streaming ingestion (Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hubs, CDC tools like Debezium).
  • Experience working alongside or building LLM/agentic tooling that interacts with databases.
  • Background in data quality and deduplication at scale (entity resolution, fuzzy matching, ML-assisted record linkage).
  • Comfort with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep) and CI/CD for database changes.

Tech Stack

  • Legacy environment: Microsoft SQL Server (3-instance DMP fleet), Azure, multi-tenant per-client database isolation
  • Modern environment: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, AWS, Docker, Railway
  • Orchestration: Airflow (rolling out on DMP)
  • Monitoring / BI: SolarWinds, Tableau
  • Tooling: Python, Docker, internal AI/LLM tools for database analysis

Where you’ll work

  • This role is fully remote. linqd., is headquartered in Endicott, NY, with team members across the country.
Salary: $119k - $140k

Renalogic is dedicated to helping our clients manage the human and financial costs of chronic kidney disease. To help us in our mission, we hire people who are humble, hungry, and smart. As the Client Success Manager, you’ll serve as the face of Renalogic to assigned clients, representing program operations, value and impact, and facilitate across stakeholders (TPAs, brokers, stop loss carriers). You’ll manage the end-to-end client experience, ensuring that new clients of Renalogic’s dialysis cost containment and clinical support programs onboard through a smooth implementation process and existing clients have ready access to program information and support when needed.

How You’ll Contribute

  • Take accountability for new-client implementation for all assigned accounts, ensuring completion of and documenting critical steps for compliance.
  • Collaborate with clients to ensure all clinical teams receive the client information necessary to provide superior member support.

  • Distribute regular program reporting and present value and impact to clients and stakeholders.
  • Retain groups year over year and actively upsell other products and create referral business.
  • Engage groups through client stewardship meetings, on-site events, and relationship-building activities.
  • Create, distribute, and present client implementation, retention, and renewal reports to internal stakeholders, including Senior Leadership and our Board of Directors.
  • Report on client KPIs and distribute quarterly client reports to key client contacts.
  • Develop relationships with key client contacts and other stakeholders; maintain a pulse on their strategic priorities and challenges, and anticipate needs, risks and opportunities.
  • Work cross functionally with internal operational teams to address client needs, issues, opportunities and customizations.

What You’ll Need to Have

  • A bachelor’s degree in business or a related field.
  • At least four years of relevant professional experience in contract management and client management within the health insurance industry is required.

  • Ability and willingness to travel multiple times a year, which will include overnight stays for corporate gatherings, conferences, and health fairs.

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Aligned Modern Health (AMH) is creating a new standard of healthcare. As the largest evidence-based holistic medicine practice in the Midwest, we operate 16 clinics across Chicago with a rapidly expanding telehealth practice that will be serving patients nationwide in 2026.

Our collaborative team of over 100 doctors, nurse practitioners, and clinicians provides personalized care for men, women and children across functional medicine, hormone health/BHRT, clinical nutrition, chiropractic care, rehabilitation and massage therapy, and acupuncture.

Using advanced diagnostics, expert-led care and individualized treatments we go beyond symptom relief to target the root causes of nagging symptoms and chronic conditions. Whether supporting gut health, fertility, thyroid and hormonal balance, autoimmune conditions, musculoskeletal pain, headaches, heart health, stress and mood disorders, weight management and a range of unresolved or undiagnosed conditions, Aligned Modern Health treats the whole person with strong doctor-patient relationships and proven clinical outcomes – empowering lasting well-being and long-term health.

We are seeking outstanding physicians to join our functional medicine team. We are looking to build up our local teams in Chicago and virtually!! We provide outstanding patient care combined with best-in-class customer experience. We are looking for licensed DCs from various states who want to be part of a dynamic and rapidly growing company and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. The compensation range is $75,000-$200,000 per year, depending on experience and includes base salary and revenue share/bonus opportunity.

Many of our current functional medicine providers have done extended work/training in the following: American Academy of Anti-Aging Medicine (A4M), American College of Lifestyle Medicine (ACLM), Institute of Functional Medicine (IFM), Diplomate of the American Board of Chiropractic Internists (DABCI), Diplomate of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition (DACBN), Functional Medicine University (FMU), and the College of Integrative Medicine (CIM) and take a data-driven approach to patient care. We manage staffing, practice management, billing and reimbursement and provide all equipment. We have a robust marketing team, and your occasional participation in marketing content creation and events is required.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments, including medical history, physical examinations, and diagnostic tests
  • Develop personalized treatment plans based on patients' needs and medical conditions
  • Prescribe nutraceuticals and/or medications and monitor their effectiveness
  • Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to coordinate patient care
  • Provide counseling and education to patients on disease prevention and healthy lifestyle choices
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records using electronic health record systems
  • Stay current with medical advancements, research, and clinical trials in the fields of functional, integrative and lifestyle medicine

Requirements:

  • At least two years of experience practicing functional medicine and performing functional medicine specialty testing/labs
  • Experience in functional and integrative medicine settings preferred
  • Must have (or be able to obtain) an IL license and any remote location determined
  • Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate and interact effectively with patients and other providers
  • Energetic and outgoing personality with a desire to help people
  • Patient first attitude and ability to consistently provide a 5-star level of service
  • Knowledge of HIPAA regulations and ability to maintain patient confidentiality

We offer competitive full-time employee benefits, including:

· Blue Cross Blue Shield medical plans, as well as dental and vision insurance

· Guaranteed paid time off

· Malpractice insurance coverage

· Reimbursement for outside CEUs/CMEs

· Eligibility for short-term disability insurance and 401(k)

· Unlimited opportunity to grow with one of Chicago’s most exciting and fastest growing health and wellness companies

Licensing Requirements: Active Illinois Chiropractic license required to start employment

Aligned Modern Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $75k - $200k

A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

**Candidate Note: This role is 100% remote for candidates based in EST or CST only**

We are seeking a Solution Developer to join our engineering team. This is a versatile role requiring a mix of full-stack web development, data pipeline engineering, and cloud infrastructure management. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining applications that involve both user-facing interfaces and complex back-end automation.

The ideal candidate is a technical generalist who is comfortable working across multiple languages (JavaScript and Python) and is eager to adopt new technologies as our stack evolves.

Your impact will be:

  • Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Next.js and Node.js.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in Python for backend services and data processing scripts.
  • Build and monitor automated workflows and data pipelines using Airflow and dbt.
  • Design and implement secure, scalable RESTful APIs.
  • Manage and deploy applications within an AWS environment, ensuring cloud best practices are followed.
  • Optimize database performance and manage data migrations in Postgres.
  • Quickly learn and implement new frameworks or tools based on project-specific requirements

What you will bring:

  • Frontend/Backend: 5+ years of experience with JavaScript/Typescript & Node.js; with deep understanding of the Next.js framework; and strong experience with API development & integrations
  • Python: Proven experience using Python for application development or data engineering.
  • Cloud: Working knowledge of AWS core services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS).
  • Data Tools: Experience in Pipeline Development, specifically transforming data with dbt and/or workflow tools like n8n along with scheduling tasks with Airflow.
  • Automation: Experience with workflow automation platforms (e.g., n8n, Zapier, or custom-built solutions).
  • Database: Strong SQL skills and experience managing PostgreSQL databases (schema designs; complex queries and optimization).
  • Version Control: Proficient in Git version control (branching, PRs, code reviews) and implementing CI/CD workflows to ensure stable, high-quality code delivery.
  • Adaptability: Ability to switch between different programming languages and technical domains (e.g., moving from a UI task to a data pipeline task).
  • Problem-Solving: A track record of identifying technical bottlenecks and implementing efficient solutions.
  • Continuous Learning: A proactive approach to learning new technologies and staying current with industry trends.

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.

About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a leading Canadian fintech company on a mission to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience. What started as a digital mortgage broker has quickly evolved into Canada's leading direct-to-consumer (D2C) online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together, nesto and CMLS Financial form the Nesto Group, Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, managing over $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages with 1,300+ team members across 12 offices nationwide.

Why Join Us

nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. You can expect to be surrounded by a talented team building lending technology on a modern tech stack and a development framework designed to unlock your full potential and accelerate your career. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Work Location

This role is open to candidates anywhere in Canada, with a preference for those in the EST time zone. Due to the nature of the role, this team participates in an on-call rotation. This is a remote position, with the option to work from any of our offices across the country.

Why We Are Hiring

We're building a new service delivery team to support major B2B partnerships – this is a ground-floor opportunity to join a team of 3, building the function from scratch, reporting to the Director of Service Delivery.

Over the next several months, the team will design and build the framework, tooling, and processes that our service runs on – everything from incident and change management to SLA reporting – before we go live. This is a build-then-operate role. The early months are about creating the playbook from scratch; once we go live, the team shifts into running and refining what we've built. This is for people who'd rather build the system than inherit one. Our current tech stack includes Datadog, Atlassian (Jira/Confluence), incident.io, and GCP.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and execute the operational framework for incident management, change management, and SLA reporting – the structure our service runs on
  • Develop problem management practices as patterns emerge from incident management, so recurring issues get solved at the root
  • Own SLA reporting end-to-end – from data pipeline design to the monthly report that lands in front of enterprise partners
  • Act as the operational face of nesto to enterprise partners – running incident bridges, presenting SLA reports, defending change decisions
  • Use AI as a core part of how you work – drafting runbooks, analyzing incident patterns, generating reports, building internal tooling. We expect this to be a force multiplier, not an occasional aid.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to keep the service reliable

What Success Looks Like

  • By our launch milestone: The incident management, change management, and SLA reporting frameworks are built, documented, and validated with our launch partner. You've run tabletop exercises and dry runs, and the team is ready to operate under contractual SLAs from day one.
  • 6 Months Post-Go-Live: We're running the operation you built, refining it with real incident and change data. Problem management practices are emerging from patterns. You're presenting monthly SLA reports to enterprise partners with confidence.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years specifically in service delivery
  • Hands-on expertise across incident, change, and problem management, plus SLA reporting – you’ve owned these, not just participated
  • Experience operating under a contractual SLA with financial penalties – not just internal targets
  • A balance of technical depth (SRE-style) and process design – you can read a system architecture diagram and write the runbook for it
  • Client-facing SaaS experience – comfortable presenting to, negotiating with, and pushing back on enterprise customers
  • Strong, assertive communication – you can hold the line in a difficult client conversation without escalating it

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in a regulated, compliance-heavy industry (banking, fintech, insurance, healthcare).
  • Familiarity with our stack: Datadog, Atlassian suite, incident.io
  • Background in SRE, sysadmin, technical account management, or business analysis.
  • Track record of using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, custom agents) to ship operational work faster – not just experimentation
  • ITIL certification or equivalent grounding in service management framework
  • Bilingual in French and English

This Role Might Be for You If

  • You're energized by building service delivery processes from scratch and thrive when there's no playbook to follow.
  • You're highly organized and process-oriented, and you know how to turn contracts and frameworks into reliable, repeatable operations
  • You stay steady and adaptable when scope is still taking shape and things need to be figured out as you go
  • You work independently and take ownership – you don't need someone checking in every two hours
  • You bring a design-minded approach to building new solutions

You Shouldn't Apply If

  • You need a fully defined, stable environment to do your best work – this role is about building from the ground up
  • You prefer to operate within an existing system rather than create one
  • You're uncomfortable being the operational face of nesto in front of enterprise customers, including during incidents
  • You see AI tools as optional or experimental rather than core to how modern service delivery gets done

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): A quick intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (30 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment / Case Study: A practical, open-ended exercise relevant to the role. We respect your time – expect ~3-4 hours of work.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): A final conversation with additional stakeholders before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Diversity and Inclusion

At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.

  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.

Location: This position is currently remote. A future transition to an on-site location on the U.S. East-Coast/Mid-West is anticipated as the project progresses, with an expected timeline in 2027. This is a full-time role with a Monday–Friday schedule from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

What you will get:

The full-time base annual salary for this position is expected to range between $203,400 to $237,300. In addition, below you will find a comprehensive summary of the benefits package we offer:

  • Performance-related bonus.

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance.

  • 401(k) matching plan.

  • Life insurance, as well as short-term and long-term disability insurance.

  • Employee assistance programs.

  • Paid time off (PTO).

Compensation for this role will be determined by the candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and relevant knowledge.

What will you do:

We are seeking a Director, Automation Lead to develop and execute the automation, digital systems, and operational technology (OT) strategy for an assigned U.S. growth investment project supporting small molecule drug substance manufacturing. This role serves as the primary automation leader throughout facility design, construction, commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, and operational handover, ensuring systems are reliable, compliant, scalable, and ready to support GMP manufacturing from day one.

  • Lead the automation workstream for an assigned U.S. growth investment project, ensuring alignment with project milestones, operational requirements, and GMP expectations

  • Define the automation strategy, architecture, and digital manufacturing roadmap, including control systems, system integration, data flows, historians, MES, and reporting solutions

  • Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, IT/OT, CSV, and EHS teams to ensure automation requirements are incorporated into facility, process, and equipment design

  • Provide leadership for automation-related commissioning, qualification, computer system validation (CSV), and start-up readiness activities

  • Manage automation vendors, system integrators, and external partners to ensure quality execution, on-time delivery, and effective risk management

  • Ensure automation systems meet regulatory, GMP, data integrity, cybersecurity, and lifecycle management requirements

  • Identify and mitigate automation, digital, and operational technology risks while providing strategic recommendations to project leadership and governance teams

  • Establish the long-term automation support model, including organizational capability, training, knowledge transfer, and operational handover to the future site team

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred

  • 12+ years of experience leading automation, OT, or digital manufacturing initiatives within pharmaceutical, API, biotechnology, chemical, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments

  • Experience supporting major capital investment projects, facility start-ups, greenfield or brownfield expansions, or large-scale manufacturing transformations

  • Strong knowledge of automation platforms, system integration, manufacturing execution systems (MES), SCADA/DCS/PLC technologies, and digital manufacturing solutions, and batch process control architectures

  • Demonstrated experience supporting small molecule drug substance or API, HPAPI, or complex chemical process manufacturing operations, including commissioning, qualification, validation, and commercial manufacturing readiness

  • Strong understanding of GMP regulations, Computer System Validation (CSV), GAMP 5 principles, data integrity requirements, and industrial cybersecurity standards

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, IT/OT, MSAT, EHS, and Project Management organizations

  • Excellent communication, strategic planning, vendor management, and problem-solving skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and project governance teams

  • Experience with ISA-88, ISA-95, and ISA/IEC 62443 frameworks, and batch process automation

  • Experience supporting multi-product API manufacturing or CDMO environments is preferred.

  • Experience integrating DCS, PLC, MES, historians, and enterprise systems across complex batch manufacturing facilities is preferred.

  • PMP, GAMP, automation, or related technical certifications

  • Experience supporting highly automated API, chemical, or small molecule manufacturing facilities

  • Ability and willingness to transition to an East Coast or Midwest U.S. site location as project needs evolve

  • Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to EMEA and NA at approximately 25-30% of the time to meet business objectives

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. Profissional de nível Arquitetura de Soluções que possua experiência em Cloud AWS.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI SDK
jobs.excerpt: About UsTemporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster.
jobs.description:
About Us

Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.
Our values guide us —they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.
Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!

Summary

We have an opening to hire a Staff Software Engineer, AI Foundations.

Temporal provides a reliable foundation powering AI leaders such as OpenAI, NVIDIA, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, and others. Its adoption is also expanding to users spanning across a broad range of AI applications. These range from agents to data pipelines and everything in between.

The mission of the AI Foundations team is to accelerate Temporal adoption across the entire ecosystem. Our approach combines a deep understanding of use cases with technical principles such as computer systems and software design fundamentals.

If you thrive on blending theory and practice, then this is the right team for you. We are an action-oriented group that loves to ship fast and solve customer problems. We also seek thorough technical grounding for our work and invest in systems and practices that foster long-term success.

Agentic development is a huge focus. We maintain a set of agents skills that give Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools a major boost when writing Temporal applications. These are already unblocking a large backlog of projects among our customer base. They also are an extraordinary point of leverage for Temporal’s mission, which has always been about accelerating developers as they build and operate reliable software. Working in this area puts you at the forefront of the agentic coding revolution.

Another major area of investment is our partner ecosystem. We developed a plugin system that makes it easy to add Temporal’s durable execution to popular open source agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI, AI SDK by Vercel, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and others. Getting these abstractions right involves both creativity and critical trade-off analysis. Many challenges of this flavor remain to be solved. As we make progress, we instill our learnings in our internal AI systems, ensuring that our people are always working to push the frontier.

We await the next AI breakthrough as eagerly as anyone, standing ready to shuffle our short-term priorities at any time. We know, however, that our long-term success and impact comes from attention to technical fundamentals and persistent trends.

Most of Temporal’s work is open source—see for yourself here:

What You Will Do

  • Work as a software engineer
  • Maintain and expand a deep understanding of agentic coding
  • Design and build agentic coding systems that we can trust to deliver high-quality outputs
  • Design and implement Temporal AI SDK features supporting a broad variety of frameworks and libraries.
  • Develop a deep understanding of AI application development patterns and techniques, including emerging approaches and architectures.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of new features, working with other teams to deliver exceptional reliability and a great developer experience.
  • Work with multiple programming languages: Python and TypeScript, Java, Go.
  • Serve as a domain expert on AI design patterns, collaborating with field staff to provide best-practices and canonical examples.
  • Work directly with our developer community to debug issues that need expert attention and get feedback on Temporal features and APIs.
  • Write public technical documentation describing Temporal concepts and APIs.
  • Go the extra mile to support a customer in need, on the rare occasion that our teams’ engineering expertise is needed.
  • Travel to meet your coworkers for a week once or twice a year.
  • Attend the occasional developer conference to talk about how great Temporal is (optional).

What You Won’t Do

  • Work as a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Devops SWE, or SRE.
  • Work in an office (unless you want to, but you’d be by yourself). Temporal is a fully-remote company.
  • Commit code that’s poorly-tested or works “most of the time”. Temporal aspires to be “Reliable as Gravity”, and we expect our code to be the same.
  • Work behind closed doors. Our work is open source—that means PRs and comments are open to the public, too.
  • Sit in meetings all day. We mostly communicate in writing, and use meetings mainly for status updates and thorny issues that need input from the whole group.
  • Wake up to pager alerts. We’re extremely active in supporting our customers and the community, but we don’t do 24/7 on-call.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of professional work experience.
  • Experience and passion for harnessing generative AI, particularly for agents and coding.
  • A deep understanding of how to use AI to increase quality, not only to increase quantity.
  • A sense of taste in code and software development practice. Your approach should be opinionated and thoughtful, but not dogmatic.
  • A track record of open source software contributions, including contributions to 3rd party libraries.
  • Fluency in multiple programming languages, and an affinity for learning new ones.
  • Deep experience with concurrent programming—you should know how to use mutexes, atomics, and other concurrency primitives safely.
  • Experience designing APIs and writing documentation for publicly-available libraries or modules.
  • Strong technical communication skills—written and verbal—in English.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or a closely-related degree), or equivalent work experience writing production-grade software.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Temporal’s programming model (e.g. you’ve written an app on Temporal).
  • Experience building agents or other AI applications
  • Background in machine learning, model training, data science, or machine learning systems.
  • Experience contributing to the architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems.
  • Graduate degree in Computer Science.

Compensation

  • The estimated pay range for this role is $224,000 - $302,400
  • Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Temporal's equity plan.
Compensation ranges reflect salary and commission compensation (when applicable) across several geographic markets. Employment offers carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, knowledge, expertise, skillset, market location, and job level assessed during the interview process.
Employee benefits and perks below are for full-time employees, part-time or temporary positions are excluded.

U.S. Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO, 12 Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
  • 100% Premiums Coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • AD&D, LT & ST Disability, and Life Insurance (Standard & Supplemental Available)
  • Empower 401K Plan
  • Additional Perks for Learning & Development, Lifestyle Spending, Home Office Setup, Professional Memberships, WFH Meals, Internet Stipend and more!

International Benefits

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Benefits outside the United States vary by country, and are issued in partnership with . Additionally, Temporal offers perks to all international employees for learning & career development, a lifestyle spending account, home office setup, professional memberships, work-from-home meals, and access to the Calm app for mental wellness.

Travel

Temporal is a globally distributed, collaborative team that values opportunities for in-person connection. Occasional travel may be required for company events, team offsites, and other meaningful moments that bring us together.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.
Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.
We are not working with external recruitment agencies, thanks.

  • Interest in working on science fiction, fantasy, horror, and speculative fiction

CRS JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Specialist I, Logistics Data & Reporting SpecialistReports to: Deputy Chief of Party - OperationsDepartment: HRD

Job Summary

The Specialist I, Logistics Data & Reporting Specialist is responsible for the consolidation, validation, and analysis of supply chain and inventory data across multiple country programs and implementing partners for a designated multi‑country, donor‑funded project. The Specialist acts as the central focal point for supply chain data within the project, the position ensures the delivery of accurate, timely, and high‑quality reporting by establishing and applying robust data governance, validation, and triangulation processes across partner and country‑level systems, including Insight. The role supports compliance with CRS and donor requirements, enhances audit readiness, and enables data‑driven decision‑making that upholds the principles of stewardship, transparency, and accountability in support of high‑quality programming for poor and vulnerable communities. The Logistics Data & Reporting Specialist may also provide limited operational and administrative support to facilitate effective project implementation.

Note: This is a remote position, and relocation is not being offered.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Project Data Governance and Quality Assurance

  • Establish and apply project-specific reporting frameworks across participating country programs and partners supporting consistent, donor‑compliant supply chain and inventory reporting.
  • Coordinate the consolidation, triangulation, and validation of supply chain and inventory data across partner submissions, financial records, and system outputs (e.g., Insight), identifying inconsistencies, anomalies, and data‑related risks.
  • Support the timely preparation of accurate project‑level donor reports and coordinate follow‑up actions with country teams and partners to address data quality and reporting gaps.

Systems Coordination and Reporting Standardization

  • Support project information management and reporting processes by promoting the effective use of MIS platforms and contributing to the consistency and quality of project data and reporting.
  • Coordinate the implementation of standardized data management practices across country teams and partners to support accurate, timely, and consistent information sharing.
  • Provide administrative and operational support for project activities, including coordinating operational requirements and maintaining compliance with agency policies, donor requirements, and applicable local regulations.

Compliance, Audit and Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with CRS policies, donor regulations, and applicable commodity accountability standards (e.g., GACAP).
  • Facilitate data preparation and coordination for internal and external audits related to the project.
  • Monitor and track discrepancies (e.g., losses, claims, inventory variances) and ensure appropriate documentation and follow-up.

Coordination and Capacity Strengthening

  • Support supply chain coordination, reporting, and information management activities, ensuring timely access to relevant information and resources for staff and partners.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination among country teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders, while supporting capacity-strengthening and project implementation activities.
  • Provide administrative and logistical support for project operations, including maintaining required documentation, stakeholder coordination, and event and travel arrangements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large, complex, multi-country donor-funded projects.
  • Experience working with partners/sub-recipients on data validation and reporting.
  • Professional certifications in supply chain or data analytics.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Familiarity with Insight ERP or similar enterprise systems.
  • Strong analytical and data validation skills
  • Knowledge of inventory accounting, GACAP, and donor compliance requirements
  • Ability to triangulate data across multiple sources and stakeholders
  • Proficiency in MIS systems (including Insight), Excel, and reporting tools
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong customer service orientation with very good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to leverage a proactive, resourceful, and results-oriented mindset.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills for reporting and donor engagement

Required Languages: English required and French, Spanish or Arabic preferred.

Travel: Must be willing and able to travel up to 25% - 30%.

Industrial Maintenance and Operations Assessor – Fire, Life, and Safety (FLS)

The Industrial Maintenance and Operations Assessor with Fire, Life, and Safety (FLS) experience will be responsible for commissioning inspections, technical audits, and consulting on fire, life, and safety systems, as well as mechanical, electrical, HVAC, and material handling equipment (MHE).

This role demands sharp attention to detail, strong technical knowledge, and a hands-on approach. The ideal candidate will have a working knowledge of industrial systems and hold relevant certifications—including NICET I/II/III/IV/V in Fire Alarm Systems (FAS), Inspection and Testing of Fire Alarm Systems (ITFAS), or Electrical Power Testing—to support accurate field assessments and ensure code compliance across various project sites.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Adheres to a Safety-First mindset in all actions.
  • Collects detailed asset data collection and performs condition assessment observations of client site FLS systems, equipment, and components for the purpose of identifying significant physical deficiencies, operability, and adherence to compliance with NFPA, NEC, and local building codes.
  • Performa functional testing and verification of Fire Life Safety systems, including fire alarms, smoke detectors, suppression systems, strobes, pull stations, emergency lighting, and mass notification systems in accordance with NFPA 72, 101, and applicable local codes.
  • Collects detailed asset data collection and performs condition assessment observations of client site structural, mechanical, and electrical equipment, and components for the purpose of identifying significant physical deficiencies and operability in accordance to recognized and generally accepted good engineering practice.
  • Conduct performance testing of medium-to-heavy electrical systems, including panelboards, switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switches (ATS), uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, and emergency generators.
  • Executes acceptance testing, load testing, and system integration testing to validate electrical infrastructure performance against design specifications and commissioning requirements.
  • Utilizes specialized testing equipment (e.g., multimeters, insulation resistance testers, power analyzers, infrared cameras, and circuit tracers) to diagnose and document system performance.
  • Maintains thorough documentation of test results, non-conformance issues, and resolution tracking for closeout and commissioning reports.
  • Conducts technical validation and auditing of major material handling conveyance equipment, new and existing, for maintenance and operability in manufacturing environments.
  • Supports commissioning and re-commissioning of MEP systems in new construction, retrofit, and mission-critical environments.
  • Participate in integrated systems testing (IST) to verify coordinated operation between fire alarm, mechanical shutdown, emergency power, and building automation systems.
  • Provides photographic documentation of equipment tags, data tags, site and building features, and documents observations in a BV proprietary data asset collection system.
  • Will utilize experience with using a CMMS program for documenting work orders, storeroom inventory usage, and asset identification.
  • Prepare detailed testing protocols, procedures, and reports to document findings, identify deficiencies, and support corrective actions.
  • Interface with contractors, engineers, and client representatives during witness testing, punch walks, and system turnover activities.
  • Ensures all testing procedures adhere to safety regulations, project standards, and applicable codes (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, NETA, etc.).
  • Prepares detailed reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends found at project site.
  • Conducts interviews with the client in order to provide the highest level of service pertaining to building and equipment systems and operations.
  • Reviews repair/improvement costs incurred by tenants/ownership along with the following documents (if available): certificate(s) of occupancy, maintenance reports and logs, Building and Fire Department inspection reports, and warranty information.
  • Maintains project-by-project communication with Lead and Senior Project Manager and keeps them informed of any actual or potential problems, including access or delivery issues.

In addition, you will:

Enhance professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

Comply with federal, state, and local legal requirements by studying new and existing legislation, anticipating future legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, and advising management on necessary action.

A demonstrated ability to use and skillfully operate a laptop computer, iPad and associated technology, programs, specialty applications, and proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications is essential for this role.

Successfully work from remote location and have good time management skills to meet work performance expectations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: This job does not have specific supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and/or Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required; trade school, technical college, or vocational school preferred.
  • Fire Science related degree highly preferred.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Fire Life Safety systems, mechanical/electrical infrastructure, or commissioning in commercial, institutional, or industrial facilities.
  • Field experience in acceptance and integrated systems testing of critical systems such as switchgear, ATS, UPS, emergency generators, and MHE.
  • NICET certification (any level I through V) in Fire Alarm Systems (FAS), Inspection and Testing of Fire Alarm Systems (ITFAS), or certification in Electrical Power Testing highly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of building automation systems (BAS), including their interaction with FLS and MEP systems.
  • Journeyman credentials in mechanical or electrical disciplines are a plus.

Specialty Qualifications:It is preferred but not required to have one or more of the following backgrounds:

  • Certified or demonstrated progress toward NICET credentials in FAS or ITFAS, or credentials in Electrical Power Testing.
  • Electrical: Practical field experience in maintenance or installation of electrical systems up to 480 volts.
  • Fire, Life, and Safety: In-depth understanding of NFPA, NEC, and local code compliance; experience conducting system inspections and interpreting test results.
  • Maintenance: Familiarity with PM programs, diagnostics, and repair of industrial MHE systems.
  • Storeroom/Inventory: Familiar with CMMS, parts recognition and usage, and maintenance tracking.
  • LOTO, lift operations, and fall protection protocols.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Valid driver's license is required with no significant MVA points/violations (clean driving record).
  • NICET I–V certification in FAS or ITFAS strongly preferred.
  • OSHA 10 certification desired.
  • Electrical Power Testing certification is a plus.

Other Qualifications:

  • Personal mobile phone and supply your own internet service.
  • Ability to use and skillfully operate a laptop computer, iPad and associated technology, programs, and applications is essential for this role.
  • Adherence to a Safety-First policy and is familiar with industry and general safety standards and regulations around industrial maintenance and fire protection codes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management skills including ability to perform multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and ability to work independently.
  • You can traverse, observe equipment, and record data and photos on safely accessible roofs and other high or open areas, which may require ladder and/or hatch access.
  • You are comfortable and willing to work in densely equipped mechanical and electrical spaces requiring dedicated focus on safety protocol.
  • Must be willing to fly and live near (or be willing to relocate to) a major metropolitan area with reasonable access to a major airport.
  • Ability to travel, on average, approximately 90% of the time to client sites across the U.S. via plane and driving as determined based on the project location.

Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe MLS is a field‑based Medical Affairs role responsible for non‑promotional, evidence‑based scientific exchange between PepsiCo and the external medical and scientific community.
jobs.description:
Overview

The MLS is a field‑based Medical Affairs role responsible for non‑promotional, evidence‑based scientific exchange between PepsiCo and the external medical and scientific community.

Operating within the unbranded, science‑centric Medical Affairs model, the MSL serves as a trusted scientific interlocutor with healthcare professionals, researchers, and academic institutions. The role supports scientific education, insight generation, and evidence translation, while operating under defined quality, compliance, and transparency frameworks.

The Scientific Liaison does not sell or promote products. All activities are conducted in alignment with Medical Affairs strategy, Medical Governance and Compliance, and applicable regulatory and Sunshine Act requirements.

Responsibilities

Scientific Exchange & Education

  • Engage in non‑promotional, evidence‑based scientific dialogue with healthcare professionals, researchers, and scientific stakeholders.
  • Communicate current scientific evidence related to hydration, nutrition, physiology, and related standards of care.
  • Support scientific education initiatives aligned with Medical Affairs objectives and approved materials.

Insight Generation

  • Gather and synthesize scientific and clinical insights from the field to inform Medical Affairs strategy, evidence generation, and research prioritization.
  • Provide structured feedback to Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and R&D teams.
  • Identify emerging scientific trends, unmet needs, and external research opportunities.

Support of Evidence Generation

  • Support clinical studies, real‑world evidence initiatives, and observational research through site engagement and scientific collaboration.
  • Facilitate compliant interactions with external investigators and academic partners.
  • Operate within approved protocols and quality standards defined by Medical Affairs and Medical Governance and Compliance.

Compliance, Quality & Transparency

  • Execute all external engagements in compliance with Medical Affairs SOPs, Medical Governance and Compliance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Adhere to Sunshine Act / transparency reporting, fair market value (FMV) standards, and documentation requirements.
  • Participate in training and quality reviews to maintain audit‑ready practices.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Medical Affairs leadership, Medical Governance and Compliance , Clinical Operations, Policy, and Legal teams as required.
  • Support internal education by sharing field insights and scientific learnings.
  • Maintain clear separation from branded marketing and sales activities.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • The expected compensation range for this position is between $123,500 - $206,750.
  • Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
  • Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 15% of annual salary paid out annually.
  • Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
  • In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, nutrition, physiology, pharmacy, medicine, or related scientific field.
  • 9+ years industry experience required in Pharmaceutical, Medical Devices, CPG, Nutrition, or related industry
  • At least 5 years experience in a Medical Science Liaison (or parallel) position required
  • Experience in Medical Affairs, scientific engagement, clinical education, or research‑facing roles.
  • Strong understanding of scientific literature, evidence evaluation, and data interpretation.
  • Familiarity with regulated scientific environments and compliance expectations.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts clearly and credibly to external experts.
  • Scientific credibility and intellectual curiosity
  • Non‑promotional role; no sales targets or brand promotion
  • Operates under Medical Affairs strategy and Medical Governance and Compliance
  • All external engagements must be approved, documented, and compliant
  • Acts as a scientific representative of PepsiCo, not a commercial one
  • Strong ethical standards and compliance mindset
  • Excellent communication and relationship‑building skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization
  • Comfort working independently in a field‑based role
  • This position is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States
