jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Go-To-Market Operations and develop and execute operational plans, organize work to meet business strategies, and evaluate functional results. You will guide, develop, and execute strategic marketing plans that support the Lottery’s mission, brand promise, and revenue goals while ensuring compliance with state regulations and responsible gaming standards. You will oversee brand identity, paid media, digital platforms, retail marketing, and external agency partnerships to drive player engagement and support game launches across all product lines. You will manage marketing staff, budgets, analytics, and customer relationship management (CRM) efforts.

    • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

  • Plan, organize, and evaluate the work of the unit while creating and sustaining an engaging and inclusive team culture.

  • Support employees in addressing and resolving conflicts directly, providing guidance as needed.

  • Create marketing strategies and plans that support revenue goals, game launches, and responsible gaming objectives.

  • Manage the marketing budget, support retailers, and ensure all advertising meets state regulations and responsible gaming standards.

  • Lead paid media management, collaborate with agencies and vendors, support game launches, and execute integrated campaigns across digital, retail, and traditional channels.

  • Manage and evolve the Lottery’s brand identity, ensure consistency across all channels, support messaging development, and maintain alignment with organizational goals.

  • Oversee digital platforms and data-driven player engagement, manage the website, app, and social media presence, and utilize CRM tools and analytics to drive retention and understand player behavior.

You Have:

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.


Position Overview

SemiAnalysis is seeking an Economist to connect our proprietary semiconductor, supply chain, and datacenter datasets with the broader macroeconomic picture.

This role will lead the firm’s research on the economics of artificial intelligence, including AI infrastructure investment, productivity growth, labor market effects, economic diffusion, and the contribution of datacenter development to GDP.

The Economist will produce flagship research that informs investors, policymakers, technology companies, and other decision-makers. The ideal candidate combines rigorous economic research, strong quantitative capabilities, and the ability to communicate complex ideas to a broad and sophisticated audience.

Responsibilities

  • Author flagship, long-form research on the macroeconomics of AI, including:

    • AI and datacenter capital expenditure cycles

    • Productivity and economic growth effects

    • GDP contribution from AI infrastructure development

    • Labor market and employment impacts

    • The economics and pace of AI adoption and diffusion

  • Build quantitative models and forecasting infrastructure that translate complex data into actionable economic insights.

  • Develop LLM-driven research and estimation pipelines that convert unstructured information—such as company filings, earnings transcripts, news reports, and planning permits—into structured economic datasets and time series.

  • Translate SemiAnalysis’s bottom-up datasets, including accelerator shipments, datacenter capacity, electricity demand, networking infrastructure, and related supply chain data, into top-down macroeconomic estimates.

  • Conduct econometric analysis and develop forecasts that can be used by investors, corporations, policymakers, and research institutions.

  • Engage with leading academic and policy debates involving:

    • Transformative AI and long-term economic growth

    • AI-driven productivity measurement

    • Explosive growth scenarios

    • Technological diffusion and innovation economics

  • Develop and communicate clear, informed views on where prevailing AI economic frameworks are accurate, incomplete, or incorrect.

  • Represent SemiAnalysis’s economic research and perspectives through client discussions, podcasts, conferences, interviews, and public writing.

  • Work closely with analysts covering semiconductors, datacenters, energy, networking, and AI systems to produce integrated research.

Requirements

  • Bachelors' Degree in Economics or equivalent professional research experience.

  • Strong research background in one or more of the following areas:

    • Macroeconomics

    • Labor economics

    • Innovation economics

    • Productivity

    • Economic growth

    • Industrial organization

  • Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous economic analysis using real-world and imperfect datasets.

  • Strong empirical, econometric, and quantitative modelling skills.

  • Proficiency in Python or another relevant programming language, with the ability to independently build data pipelines, models, and forecasting tools.

  • Ability to collect, clean, structure, and analyze large amounts of messy or unstructured information.

  • Strong written communication skills, with experience producing research for audiences beyond a narrow academic specialization.

  • Evidence of widely read research, long-form journalism, essays, publications, or other analytical writing.

  • Genuine and informed interest in the economics of AI, including familiarity with transformative AI, productivity, automation, and technological growth debates.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced research environment where accuracy, originality, and speed are equally important.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience integrating large language models into quantitative research workflows, including:

    • Agent-based research pipelines

    • Structured data extraction

    • Automated classification

    • Forecasting and estimation systems

  • Previous experience at a:

    • Central bank

    • Government or policy institution

    • Sell-side economics research team

    • Investment research firm

    • Economics-focused publication

  • Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing, AI accelerators, datacenter infrastructure, energy markets, or networking systems.

  • Experience translating technical or industry-specific datasets into broader economic indicators and forecasts.

  • Strong public communication skills, including experience speaking with clients, appearing on podcasts, presenting research, or engaging with the media.

  • Ability to form independent views and challenge established economic assumptions using new evidence.

Growth Areas

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Define and build SemiAnalysis’s economics research coverage from the ground up.

  • Become a leading public voice on the macroeconomic consequences of artificial intelligence.

  • Develop proprietary economic indicators based on unique semiconductor, datacenter, energy, and supply chain datasets.

  • Expand into new research areas such as AI investment cycles, sovereign AI strategies, labor displacement, productivity measurement, and long-term economic growth.

  • Build advanced forecasting and research infrastructure using econometrics, machine learning, and LLM-driven workflows.

  • Work directly with investors, technology companies, policymakers, central banks, and other institutions shaping the development and adoption of AI.

  • Publish research with the potential to move markets, influence corporate strategy, and inform economic policy.

  • Grow into a leadership position overseeing economics research, forecasting, and broader macroeconomic coverage within SemiAnalysis.

jobs.excerpt: Wyoming Rural Healthcare Quality, Compliance and Risk Leadership OpportunitiesRural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced leaders in quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, and regulatory readiness.
jobs.description:
Wyoming Rural Healthcare Quality, Compliance and Risk Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced leaders in quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, and regulatory readiness.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, and regulatory leadership opportunities across Wyoming.

These opportunities may include positions within Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, community hospitals, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

Explore Rural Healthcare Opportunities at RSSJobs.org

This application may connect you with the specific opportunity you were viewing, as well as other current or upcoming rural healthcare positions throughout Wyoming that align with your experience and goals.

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare opportunities and communities.

This Is More Than a Compliance Role

In rural healthcare, quality, compliance, and risk leaders help protect patients, employees, and the long-term stability of the organization.

These professionals support safe care, strong systems, regulatory readiness, and a culture where concerns can be identified and addressed before they become larger problems.

The strongest leaders understand that quality and compliance are not simply about policies, audits, or survey preparation. They are about helping people do their best work, strengthening trust, improving outcomes, and making sure the organization can continue serving its community.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Quality Director or Manager
  • Compliance Officer
  • Director or Manager of Compliance
  • Risk Manager
  • Director of Risk Management
  • Patient Safety Director or Manager
  • Performance Improvement Director or Manager
  • Regulatory Affairs Director or Manager
  • Accreditation or Survey Readiness Leadership
  • Infection Prevention Director or Manager
  • Privacy or Ethics Leadership
  • Clinical Quality Leadership
  • Quality Improvement Coordinator or Supervisor
  • Senior quality, compliance, risk, or regulatory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing leadership for quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, or regulatory programs
  • Supporting a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Monitoring quality indicators, patient outcomes, incidents, and performance trends
  • Leading investigations, root cause analyses, and corrective action planning
  • Developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and compliance programs
  • Supporting regulatory surveys, accreditation visits, audits, and readiness activities
  • Managing risk identification, reporting, mitigation, and follow-up
  • Supporting infection prevention and employee or patient safety initiatives
  • Educating employees and leaders on quality, compliance, privacy, and regulatory expectations
  • Partnering with clinical, operational, HR, finance, and executive teams
  • Preparing reports and recommendations for executive leadership and governing boards
  • Tracking improvement plans and helping departments sustain progress
  • Supporting grievance, complaint, incident, and event-review processes
  • Helping the organization respond to changing regulations and standards
  • Building systems that are practical, consistent, and understandable for employees

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive experience in healthcare quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, or regulatory affairs
  • Previous leadership experience as a director, manager, officer, supervisor, or comparable professional
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, quality improvement, and risk-management practices
  • Experience with audits, investigations, corrective action plans, or survey readiness
  • Strong analytical, communication, education, and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to work collaboratively across clinical and operational departments
  • Experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, public hospital districts, long-term care, or community healthcare organizations
  • Relevant education, licensure, or certification based on the position
  • A practical, fair, and relationship-focused leadership style

Some opportunities may require or prefer credentials such as CPHQ, CHC, CHPC, CPPS, CIC, ARM, RN, or another quality, compliance, risk, privacy, safety, or clinical credential. Requirements will depend on the specific position.

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. These organizations often operate with lean teams and broad responsibilities, making strong quality, compliance, and risk leadership especially important.

Working in this area within a rural organization offers the opportunity to create meaningful improvements, support employees directly, and help protect healthcare access for an entire community.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, and regulatory leadership opportunities that align with your experience, goals, preferred location, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Wyoming communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, position, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Discover More Rural Healthcare Opportunities

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare positions, leadership opportunities, and communities throughout Wyoming.

Work Where It Matters.

Built for Rural.

jobs.description:

We are seeking an engineering leader responsible for end-to-end delivery of every DGX compute system—from firmware through the AI stack to customer deployment. You will ensure each DGX product ships as a production-ready system where firmware, OS, drivers, CUDA, networking, and AI applications work together seamlessly, while driving architecture and roadmap for next-generation platforms.

What you’ll be doing:

  • End-to-End Stack Readiness: Ensure every DGX platform is ready for the full NVIDIA software stack—firmware, DGX OS, GPU drivers, CUDA toolkit, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, and management tools—as a validated, production-quality product. Own the GA SW/FW release process delivering firmware bundles, BaseOS ISOs, and release notes to OEM/OSV partners. Ensure platforms support AI agents like NemoClaw, Hermes agents, NIM microservices, and workloads customers expect out of the box.

  • Platform Firmware Development: Lead development of the manageability firmware stack (BMC, BIOS) for all DGX platforms. Ensure firmware from partner teams (GPU, CPU, networking) integrates correctly at system level. Manage 3rd-party vendors and drive platform requirements (NVPOR) across all firmware areas.

  • Validation Strategy: Define validation strategy proving each DGX platform is production-ready: end-to-end system validation including firmware regression, NVQual certification, DL workload performance, OS/CUDA stack testing, multi-user scenarios, power/thermal validation, and field upgrade reliability. Establish quality gates and zero ship-stopper discipline.

  • Platform Bring-Up & Architecture: Drive platform bring-up for each new DGX system—coordinating first boot across new silicon (CPU, GPU), board design, and firmware teams. Own architectural strategy for next-generation platforms including firmware update mechanisms, system security posture, and AI application readiness.

  • Customer Deployment & Enablement: Ensure firmware release flows meet CSP and enterprise deployment requirements. Represent DGX platform readiness in executive reviews and strategic planning with VP/SVP leadership. Engage with industry standards bodies (DMTF Redfish, OCP).

  • Product Delivery Lifecycle: Own the complete DGX delivery lifecycle—system architecture, firmware development, integration, full-stack validation, GA release, and customer deployment—for every DGX product.

  • Cross-Org Alignment: Serve as single point of accountability for DGX platform readiness across NVIDIA—aligning GPU, CPU, networking, security, OS, and AI software teams to deliver on schedule.

  • Quality & Vendor Management: Own RCCA processes for field issues. Manage external vendor partnerships (AMI for SBIOS, BMC contributors) with clear quality gates and program tracking.

  • Team Leadership: Build and lead a world-class engineering organization. Mentor and develop leaders. Foster a culture of technical excellence, intellectual honesty, and customer obsession.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience.

  • 12+ overall years in systems firmware/software engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership.

  • Deep expertise in server system stack including SBIOS, BMC, OS, applications and system-level integration of complex multi-component products.

  • Proven track record delivering multi-generation server or data center platforms from architecture through customer deployment.

  • Experience managing engineering organizations across multiple geographies in a matrix environment.

  • Strong understanding of server hardware: CPU, GPU, interconnect, memory, PCIe, power delivery.

  • Experience owning end-to-end product quality—from firmware validation through full-stack system testing to field deployment.

jobs.excerpt: Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people.
jobs.description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.

We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.

We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Creative Director to be the strategic and aesthetic engine behind our most complex client projects. You'll bridge brand strategy and physical experience, acting as the lead architect of the event journey for our clients’ corporate events. You'll blend traditional design principles with emerging AI tools to create immersive environments that tell a real story. This is a high-level individual contributor role who will own concept to final delivery and work with specialized external talent to bring it to life.

What you'll own

  • Vision: Leading the vision for ideal solutions and event outcomes inclusive of estimating hours and costs at a high level

  • AI-enhanced concepting and narrative development: Utilizing AI tools (e.g. Midjourney, DALL-E, Adobe Firefly) and Adobe Creative Suite to create photorealistic concept art and "day-in-the-life" guest journey visualizations during the pitch phase + Using LLMs (e.g. Gemini, Claude) to refine event themes, scripts, and messaging frameworks, ensuring a cohesive "voice" across all event communications

  • Brand stewardship: ensuring every physical and digital touchpoint from stage design to registration reflects the client's brand

  • Sustainable design: proposing creative solutions that prioritize circularity and minimize environmental impact

  • Advanced presentation design: Move beyond static slides. Build dynamic, cinematic presentations (using PPT, Keynote, or Gamma/Beautiful.ai) that sell a vision, not just a plan

  • Spatial and multimodal design: conceptualizing how physical spaces interact with digital layers (AR, spatial computing, interactive LED)

  • Freelancer orchestration: identifying, briefing, and directing specialized external talent (ex: 3D renderers, motion designers, AI artists) to execute specific project components

Who you are

  • You're a builder of experiences. You see a blank page as an opportunity, not a problem. You dream outside the box but stay grounded in what actually works on the event floor.

  • You love the complexity of a full-scale conference and understand how the event website, foyer, breakouts, and main stage all work together, as well as how event tech (LED panels, lighting, sound) can be used creatively

  • You believe AI is already changing the creative workflow. You're fluent in the tools and have strong opinions about what they're for and what they aren't for

  • You can stand in front of a CMO and explain why your creative direction will drive their business goals

  • You have an uncompromising eye for typography, spatial flow, and color theory, even if you're not in the weeds of the design

  • You treat production, tech, and freelance partners as collaborators, not service providers

  • You own the work from concept through the final onsite walkthrough, ensuring every single deliverable points back to the event vision

What you have

  • 8+ years of experience in experiential marketing, event production, or high-end experience-driven agency environments.

  • A maker's portfolio: live or hybrid experiences you conceived and delivered, not just supported. We want to see that you’ve designed general session stages and conference themes.

  • Drive: Proven ability to own a project from first brainstorm to final delivery without relying on a team underneath you

  • AI fluency: Hands-on use of AI tools for visual ideation, moodboarding, and narrative development, not theoretical interest

  • Software mastery: Expert-level PowerPoint. Adobe Creative Cloud familiarity. SketchUp, Rhino, or AI generation tools are a strong plus

  • Evidence of scale: Fortune 500 brand work, $1M+ productions, or 500+ attendee experiences

The Impact

Within 1 month, you'll:

  • Learn internal Creative Services processes and proprietary tools like Backstage

  • Deeply understand the Meeting Tomorrow brand and the value we provide to clients

  • Shadow active projects and meet our key production, sales, and freelance partners

  • Build your first AI-enhanced mood board for a live or prospective client opportunity

Within 3 months, you'll:

  • Lead creative on at least one complex client project from pitch through concept delivery

  • Curate a freelance bench of 3D renderers, motion designers, and AI artists we can pull from

Within 6 months, you'll:

  • Own creative direction on a marquee project with measurable client impact

  • Set the standard for how our presentations sell a vision rather than a plan

  • Influence how the creative team prices, pitches, and delivers high-end experiential work across the agency

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision plan options

• Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access

• 401k with employer matching up to 4%

• 16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays

• Annual profit-sharing bonus

• 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)

• $50 Monthly fitness reimbursement

• Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell

• Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)

• Regular social events and learning opportunities

At Meeting Tomorrow, our mission is to foster a culture of respect and affection. We embrace our differences and are committed to having a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in second chances and strongly encourages BIPOC, women, LGBTQIA, veterans, persons with disabilities, formerly incarcerated and all other individuals to apply.

What makes Meeting Tomorrow’s culture so special is the people, and we look for candidates who are a match for our company’s core values: commitment, kindness and humility. If those words describe you and you see yourself in this posting, you’re ready to apply!

jobs.description:
SUMMARY:

Claim Representative II:

This is the intermediate level of the claim handler career path. Handles moderate to difficult claims. Exercises progressively more discretion in the determination of compensability of claims. Considers many factors in the determination claim reserves. Negotiates and settles claims within given authority. Works remotely with occasional travel to on-site visits with insured municipalities. Is a resident in the State of Michigan

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Verifies coverage of claimed property and casualty damage.

  • Determines liability for covered claims by thorough investigation of the claim and applicable exclusions.

  • Analyzes liability for claims pursuant to Michigan municipal liability statutes and caselaw.

  • Establishes timely and appropriate reserves based on the profile of the claim within given authority based on anticipated financial exposure.

  • Documents specifics of claims with potential for subrogation recovery, including amount of potential recovery monies.

  • Manages estimates and invoices for property, casualty and automobile claims, and approves payments based on support showing relationship to the cause of loss and legal liability for payment.

  • Concludes and closes files following resolution of claims to meet internal performance standards while complying with state legislation to avoid penalties and manage expenses.

  • Negotiates settlements with attorneys or injured parties within given authority at the earliest possible point to bring cases to final disposition.

  • Works closely with manager on complex files or files above settlement/reserve authority.

  • Manages outside vendors to ensure cost containment efforts.

  • Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with all internal and external customers.

  • Stays abreast of changes in municipal liability statutes and case law in order to accurately interpret and apply relevant laws.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Administers complex claims and catastrophic exposures within authority, including claims from dedicated large accounts.
  • Exercises independent judgment to settle cases prior to mediation or litigation.
  • Actively participates in agent/client relationship management.
  • Assists in mentoring team members.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION OR EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required. Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE:

Claim Representative II:

Three years experience in property and casualty claims environment which provides the necessary skills, knowledge and abilities, such as experience in reviewing policy coverages and exclusions, drafting coverage letters, investigating and settling property and casualty losses, and adjusting claims through litigation and trial. Experience handling claims in multiple jurisdictions preferred. Bilingual skills preferred.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

  • Ability and proficiency in the use of computers and company standard software specific to position.

  • Knowledge of medical and legal terminology related to the work.

  • Knowledge of Michigan municipal liability.

  • Knowledge of best practices for adjusting property losses.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Effective customer service skills.

  • Ability to negotiate, build consensus and resolve conflict.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.

  • Attention to detail and analytical skills.

  • Ability to work independently as well as within a team.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

Claim Representative II, III:

  • Ability to make independent decisions.
  • Ability to solve complex problems.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed in an office setting with no unusual hazards. Minimal travel required.

PAY RANGE:

Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market, and other potential factors. It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $56,700 - $94,900.

Job Title: Director of Enterprise Systems

Job Location: Work at Home, Texas, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

POSITION SUMMARY

CVS Health Digital is looking for hands-on, passionate people who want to join a high energy and growing team to make a difference in customers’ lives and who want to be on the forefront of digital innovation that aims to reinvent what a pharmacy and a health care company can be in the digital world. Currently, we are seeking a Director of Enterprise Systems who will play a vital role in leading the engineering transformation and optimization of our HP NonStop (Tandem) platform. This Director will provide strategic leadership to HP NonStop infrastructure engineering, DevOps, and automation teams, driving modern engineering practices and ensuring the successful delivery of mission-critical solutions that align with business objectives. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership experience in enterprise-class platform engineering, with expertise in DevOps methodologies, infrastructure automation, and modern software development practices that can be applied to HP NonStop environments.

Expectations for the Role:

Leadership and Strategy

  • Develop and execute engineering strategies for the HP NonStop infrastructure landscape and the enterprise Performance Engineering practice that align with organizational goals and business objectives, including the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities
  • Lead and mentor teams of platform engineers, DevOps specialists, automation engineers, and performance engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and modern engineering practices
  • Recruit, train, and retain high-performing engineering talent with expertise in enterprise platforms, DevOps, automation technologies, performance engineering, and emerging AI-driven solutions
  • Provide thought leadership on platform engineering, DevOps transformation, infrastructure automation, AI-enabled operations, and performance engineering best practices
  • Drive the adoption of modern engineering methodologies including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and site reliability engineering principles within enterprise platform environments
  • Develop strategic performance engineering roadmaps, implement and monitor SLAs, and track team performance metrics across all areas of responsibility

Platform Engineering and DevOps

  • Lead the transformation of HP NonStop systems management through modern DevOps practices, automation frameworks, and AIOps capabilities
  • Architect and implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment strategies for HP NonStop applications and infrastructure
  • Drive infrastructure automation initiatives, including AI-assisted operations and predictive analytics, using tools and methodologies that can be adapted to HP NonStop environments
  • Establish monitoring, observability, and alerting solutions that leverage AI-driven anomaly detection to provide comprehensive visibility into HP NonStop system performance and health
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code practices and configuration management for HP NonStop systems
  • Champion containerization, microservices, and cloud-native principles where applicable to HP NonStop workloads

Performance Engineering

  • Supervise and direct the team of Performance Engineers, including contractors
  • Establish and maintain enterprise-wide performance testing standards and drive the adoption of advanced performance monitoring, analytics, and AI-powered predictive capabilities
  • Manage the performance testing intake process and report on project metrics
  • Own enterprise performance testing tools, including LoadRunner, and associated VM server infrastructure
  • Own the non-production development and test environments supporting performance engineering activities
  • Participate in project delivery activities including monthly releases, migrations, upgrades, and deployments

Engineering Excellence and Innovation

  • Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of HP NonStop systems using modern engineering principles
  • Drive API-first development and integration strategies to modernize HP NonStop application interfaces
  • Implement automated testing frameworks, including AI-augmented testing, unit testing, integration testing, and performance testing for HP NonStop applications
  • Establish engineering standards, code review processes, and quality gates for HP NonStop development
  • Foster a culture of experimentation and innovation, encouraging the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies including artificial intelligence and machine learning
  • Collaborate with architecture teams to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable HP NonStop solutions

Security and Compliance Engineering

  • Implement security-by-design principles and DevSecOps practices for HP NonStop systems
  • Automate security scanning, vulnerability assessment, and compliance reporting processes, leveraging AI-driven threat detection where applicable
  • Design and implement automated security controls and monitoring for HP NonStop environments
  • Drive vulnerability compliance remediations and support audit initiatives across all owned platforms and tooling

Cross-Platform Collaboration and Integration

  • Collaborate with teams managing other enterprise platforms (mainframe, Unix, Linux, cloud) to share best practices and drive consistency
  • Lead integration initiatives between HP NonStop systems and modern cloud platforms, APIs, and microservices
  • Drive standardization of tooling, monitoring, logging, and observability across diverse platform environments

Vendor and Technology Management

  • Establish and maintain relationships with HPE, DevOps tool vendors, performance testing tool vendors, AI and automation platform providers, and contractor vendors
  • Evaluate and implement modern tooling and technologies, including AI-powered solutions, that enhance HP NonStop and performance engineering capabilities
  • Coordinate with vendors for platform modernization, automation tools, and engineering support services

Budget and Resource Management

  • Manage budgets for HP NonStop engineering, performance engineering operations, automation tools, AI initiatives, and platform modernization efforts
  • Make strategic decisions on tooling, technology investments, and resource allocation to maximize engineering efficiency
  • Track and report on engineering productivity metrics, automation ROI, and platform modernization progress

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of proven experience in enterprise-class platform engineering
  • 7+ years of experience in any of the following platforms: HP NonStop, IBM mainframe (z/OS), IBM iSeries (AS/400), Unix/Linux enterprise systems, or large-scale distributed systems
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering teams, including direct reports and contractors, with a demonstrated ability to drive transformation and foster innovation in complex technical environments
  • Deep expertise in DevOps methodologies, including CI/CD pipeline design, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and automated testing frameworks
  • Experience with performance testing methodologies, tools (such as LoadRunner), and quality assurance practices in enterprise environments
  • Proven track record in platform modernization and transformation initiatives in enterprise environments
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Splunk, or similar platforms
  • Knowledge of API development and integration patterns, microservices architecture, and cloud-native technologies
  • Experience with security automation, DevSecOps practices, and vulnerability compliance remediation in enterprise environments
  • Strong understanding of site reliability engineering (SRE) principles and practices, with a focus on MTTD/MTTR
  • Experience with disaster recovery automation and business continuity planning for critical enterprise systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Previous experience with HP NonStop (Tandem) systems, including NonStop OS, NonStop SQL/MX, or NonStop application development
  • Experience with financial services or healthcare transaction processing systems
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development practices
  • Familiarity with AIOps, AI-driven testing, or machine learning applications in infrastructure management, performance engineering, or security operations
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, technology budgets, and resource allocation for engineering initiatives
  • Experience establishing and maintaining enterprise-wide performance testing standards and strategic performance engineering roadmaps
  • Experience implementing and monitoring SLAs and engineering team performance metrics
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and capacity to manage complex engineering projects across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders
  • Experience managing non-production development and test environments in large enterprise settings
  • ITIL Foundation or higher
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud certifications
  • DevOps or SRE-related certifications (e.g., AWS DevOps Engineer, Google SRE, Docker/Kubernetes certifications)
  • Performance testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB Performance Testing, LoadRunner certification)

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree or, equivalent experience (HS diploma + 4 years relevant experience)

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. Job Title: Lead Instructor: MLOps / AI Platform Engineering

Company: General Assembly

Client: Confidential – Customer Success Reskilling

Location: Remote (Must work West Coast / Pacific Time hours)

Duration: 2 Weeks (Starting Mid-June)

Commitment: Roughly 30 hours per week

Compensation: $11,500 - $15,500 (Estimated lump sum payment for one 60-hour program)

About the Engagement

General Assembly is delivering a specialized reskilling program designed to transition Customer Success and Account Management professionals into MLOps and AI Platform Engineering roles.

As the Lead Instructor, you will be the face of lessons. You aren't just checking the math; you are bridge-building. You will lead experienced customer-facing professionals through the complexities of taking AI systems from pilot to production, ensuring they leave the 2-week intensive with a functional understanding of MLOps governance and deployment.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Live Instruction: Deliver high-energy, synchronous remote lectures and "prompt-along" sessions covering ML pipelines, model deployment, and monitoring.
  • Simplify the Complex: Translate high-level MLOps concepts (CI/CD for ML, governance frameworks) into digestible insights for learners who are experienced professionals but not career engineers.
  • Facilitate Hands-on Labs: Guide students through self-paced exercises and live troubleshooting within the Azure AI Foundry and ML environments.
  • Mentor & Office Hours: Provide real-time feedback during dedicated lab hours, helping students navigate technical roadblocks in Python and Azure infrastructure.
  • Drive Learning Outcomes: Ensure students can successfully articulate and execute model lifecycle management strategies by the end of the cohort.

What You Bring

  • The Experience: 7+ years in software or data engineering, with at least 3+ years specifically in MLOps or ML platform roles in a production environment.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

HR leaders often work across every department and help shape the employee experience from the first conversation through onboarding, development, retention, and long-term engagement.

The strongest rural HR leaders are approachable, thoughtful, and trusted. They understand employment law and policy, but they also understand people. They can support employees, advise leaders, navigate difficult situations, and help build a workplace where people feel respected and valued.

In smaller rural organizations, HR leaders may have broad responsibility across recruitment, employee relations, benefits, compensation, compliance, workforce planning, and culture.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Human Resources Director
  • Human Resources Manager
  • Vice President of Human Resources
  • Chief Human Resources Officer
  • People and Culture Director
  • Employee Relations Director or Manager
  • Talent Acquisition Director or Manager
  • Workforce Development Director
  • Recruitment Manager
  • Benefits and Compensation Manager
  • HR Business Partner Leadership
  • Organizational Development Leadership
  • Learning and Development Leadership
  • Payroll and HR Operations Leadership
  • Senior HR generalist or supervisory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership for human resources
  • Supporting recruitment, onboarding, retention, and workforce planning
  • Advising executives, managers, and employees on workplace matters
  • Strengthening employee engagement, communication, and organizational culture
  • Leading employee relations, investigations, and conflict resolution
  • Overseeing compensation, benefits, leave administration, and HR operations
  • Supporting performance management and leadership development
  • Developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and employee handbooks
  • Ensuring compliance with employment laws, regulations, and organizational standards
  • Supporting labor relations or collective bargaining, when applicable
  • Managing credentialing, background checks, or workforce compliance processes
  • Improving HR systems, reporting, and documentation
  • Building recruitment strategies for hard-to-fill rural healthcare roles
  • Supporting organizational change, restructuring, growth, or leadership transitions
  • Helping employees and leaders feel informed, supported, and heard

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive human resources leadership experience
  • Experience as an HR Director, HR Manager, HR Business Partner, Talent Acquisition leader, or comparable professional
  • Knowledge of employment law, employee relations, recruitment, benefits, compensation, and HR compliance
  • Experience advising executives and department leaders
  • Strong communication, discretion, and conflict-resolution skills
  • Experience building or improving HR policies, systems, and processes
  • Experience with healthcare workforce challenges and hard-to-fill positions
  • Rural hospital, Critical Access Hospital, FQHC, public hospital district, long-term care, or community healthcare experience
  • A bachelor's degree in human resources, business, healthcare administration, or a related field
  • Relevant certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR may be preferred
  • A collaborative, fair, and relationship-focused leadership style

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. These organizations often compete for talent with larger systems while relying on smaller teams to carry broad responsibilities.

Human resources leadership in a rural setting offers the opportunity to shape culture, strengthen retention, support leaders, and help ensure the organization has the people it needs to continue serving the community.
