Working on the Platinum Support Team, the Support Account Manager is the main technical support contact serving Sprinklr’s largest and most complex customers. We work with program managers and executive level decision makers at large enterprise brands to deliver excellent customer support experience.

Platinum Support Account Manager also acts as an internal escalation point, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering & Services to resolve issues.

The PSAM also acts as the day-to-day internal escalation point, and point of contact for clients, ensuring optimal client service as it relates to platform performance, functionality, enhancements, and optimization while supporting line management and operational excellence.

  • Experience with logging tools (GrayLog, Kibana, Grafana).

About the Opportunity

Nemours Radiology is seeking three additional Pediatric Radiologists to join our current overnight group as a 100% remote nighthawk, 1 week on and 2 weeks off model. This position is 100% pediatric imaging, with no fluoroscopy responsibilities, and the provider will be paired with an additional radiologist overnight. Emergency neuroradiology experience is preferred but not required. We offer a competitive salary and generous signing bonus.

Division Highlights

Nemours Radiology is one of the largest pediatric radiology groups in the United States, currently composed of 46 pediatric radiologists, growing to over 50 in 2026, working together to provide state-of-the-art diagnostic and interventional radiology services at our locations in Delaware, Florida, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. In 2025, we are on track to preform 500,000 imaging examinations across the growing system. The enterprise is integrated within a single PACS, with faculty working from shared worklists, participating in multi-site conferences and initiatives, and sharing after-hours responsibilities including a current dedicated team of 3 nighthawk radiologists. We have collaborative research opportunities supported by dedicated leadership, PhD’s, and a radiology research fellowship. We are also active educationally with Pediatric Radiology and Pediatric Neuroradiology fellowships at our Orlando, FL and Wilmington, DE campuses and radiology residents from multiple programs rotating through the department. Pediatric Radiology fellows are expected to rotate with the nighthawk team during their fellowship year.

Nemours Radiology provides full pediatric imaging services (diagnostic and interventional) for Nemours Children’s Hospital, Delaware, in Wilmington, Nemours Children’s Hospital, Florida, in Orlando, Nemours Children’s Specialty Care in Jacksonville, FL, Nemours Children’s Clinic at Studer Family Children's Hospital at Ascension Sacred Heart in Pensacola, FL, Wolfson Children’s Hospital in Jacksonville, FL as well as several hospital partners for pediatric radiology. Faculty are licensed in all four states and credentialed throughout the system as well as partner institutions. In-house moonlighting is also available.

Academic appointment is available but not required for our emergency radiology section.

  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits: health, life, dental, vision
  • Mortgage assistance, relocation packages and 403B with employer match, 457 retirement savings plan

jobs.description:
Product Support Associate (Tier 1 Support) — 2 Openings
Preferred locations: Philippines (or similar UTC+8 region) + Central America (UTC-6)

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our proprietary computer-vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities. Our platform delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering healthcare providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

The Role

As Teton's Product Support Associate, you'll serve as the front line of Tier 1 support for our Customer Success organization- monitoring support channels, triaging incoming issues, and resolving or routing them fast so CS can stay focused on client relationships and outcomes rather than operational firefighting.

We're hiring Product Support Associates, each based in a time zone that complements US coverage hours, so that between the two roles and the US team, support is covered around the clock.

You'll own first response across support channels, working from defined SOPs to investigate, categorize, and resolve straightforward issues, and to escalate complex ones to the right team (CS, Engineering, Deployment, or Product) with clear, well-documented context.

This is a foundational role on a growing Support function- you'll help build on the playbooks as much as follow it, and there's a clear path to more ownership as the team scales into Phase 2.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will lead and oversee:

First response- monitor all regional support channels and respond to inbound support messages

Ticket triage- investigate issues, categorize by type (Detection, App, Connectivity, Desktop, Hardware), and create Support or Hardware Maintenance tickets per existing SOP

Engineering escalation- create well-documented engineering tickets where required and tag the appropriate teams

Install validation- assist the deployment teams to confirm hardware is online and correctly set up post-install in coordination.

Device monitoring- check device online/offline status, flag anomalies, and take defined first-response actions

Source trigger routing- keep up with source trigger events and route them appropriately based on initial investigation

Schedule

Shift length: 8 hours/day, 5 days/week covering UK morning/US overnight + UK evening/US daytime

Weekend coverage: Every other weekend, with the two Support Associates alternating so one is always on for weekend coverage

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications: 1–2 years of experience in a Tier 1 IT help desk or technical support role

Comfort with SaaS support tooling and structured ticket workflows

Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with healthcare facility staff at varying levels of tech literacy

High attention to detail, ability to follow defined escalation protocols, and self-directed during shifts with minimal overlap with the core US team

Mindset:

You're energized by working alongside an international team that moves fast and turns technology into real workflow wins with clients

Direct, transparent communicator who escalates early, brings solutions with the problem, and wants teammates who operate the same way

You thrive in rapid iteration and don't need a finished process to do great work

Genuinely curious about AI, computer vision, and how emerging technology actually lands in healthcare settings

You want to do the best work of your career at a company that's genuinely changing how care gets delivered

Preferred Qualifications:

Healthcare or senior living familiarity- willingness to learn Teton's clinical context quickly

Experience with Slack-based or similar support workflows and structured handoff processes

Prior experience at an early-stage SaaS or healthcare technology company

Prior experience working a shift-based or follow-the-sun support schedule, including weekend rotations

What We Offer

Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

401(k) plan, paid time off, health insurance.

What It's Like Working at Teton

We're a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged- it's expected. It's a hands-on environment where you'll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job – jump on board 😊

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Excess Liability Insurance Underwriter

DEPARTMENT: Brooks Insurance Agency

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Brooks Insurance Agency is the wholesale brokerage of Venbrook Group, LLC, a holding company with subsidiaries engaged in retail broking, wholesale broking, programs, and claims services. As an independent, multi‑line wholesaler in the property and casualty marketplace, Brooks Insurance provides coverage on both an excess and surplus (E&S) and admitted basis.

Brooks Insurance works across standard markets and specializes in distressed and complex lines of business. Our strong premium volume reinforces our carrier relationships, positioning Brooks Insurance as a preferred partner and ensuring priority submission review and exceptional service.

Brooks Insurance is the wholesale brokerage of Venbrook. At Venbrook, we envision a world where our clients can confidently pursue their boldest ambitions. Our team of experts leverages agility, innovation, and creative problem-solving to guide our clients through an ever-changing risk environment. We pride ourselves on providing insurance services that allow businesses to make bold decisions, knowing their risks are identified, assessed, and mitigated.

Our culture is derived from the people who create it. We are not different in what we do. We are different in how we do it. We believe our clients are our partners, and we earn their trust every day. We believe in empowering our team and holding ourselves accountable to deliver the best solutions. We value agility, versatility, innovation and creative problem solving and put our people at the core of everything we do.

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package:

  • 401k + employee match
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental leave
  • Paid Sick leave
  • Professional development programs
  • Work-life quality and flexibility

Visit us at

JOB SUMMARY:

The Excess Liability Insurance Underwriter evaluates, selects, and prices excess and surplus (E&S) casualty risks within delegated underwriting authority. This is a technical carrier underwriting role focused on sound risk selection, disciplined pricing, portfolio profitability, and documentation quality across a broad range of target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific risks, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures. The underwriter works within the carrier’s underwriting guidelines and appetite to make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Sound Judgment & Underwriting Authority: Exercises disciplined analytical thinking to evaluate complex excess casualty risk exposures and make binding underwriting decisions within delegated authority limits. Balances risk quality with portfolio profitability.

Technical Underwriting Depth: Demonstrates strong command of excess and surplus lines casualty underwriting principles, coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology across multiple target classes.

Portfolio & Market Awareness: Monitors loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to proactively adjust underwriting strategies and maintain a profitable, disciplined book of business.

Broker & Carrier Collaboration: Builds and maintains effective working relationships with wholesale brokers and internal carrier teams. Communicates underwriting decisions clearly, including rationale for pricing, coverage structure, or declinations.

Attention to Detail & Documentation: Thoroughly reviews applications, loss history, and exposure data. Produces clear, accurate underwriting files that reflect sound decision-making and comply with carrier guidelines, surplus lines regulations, and audit standards.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Risk Assessment & Underwriting Authority

  • Analyze complex excess casualty risk submissions, including underlying primary programs, loss history, and exposure data
  • Evaluate risks across target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures
  • Underwrite excess and surplus (E&S) lines submissions that fall outside standard market appetite
  • Make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements within delegated underwriting authority
  • Determine appropriate coverage structures, attachment points, limits, terms, conditions, and endorsements in accordance with underwriting guidelines
  • Refer risks outside delegated authority to senior underwriting leadership with a clear, documented recommendation
  • Apply surplus lines regulatory knowledge in structuring and transacting placements appropriately

Portfolio & Profitability Management

  • Maintain a profitable book of business through disciplined risk selection and consistent application of underwriting guidelines
  • Monitor loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to adjust underwriting strategies
  • Collaborate with carrier actuarial teams to refine pricing models and ensure rate adequacy
  • Identify and escalate portfolio-level concerns, deteriorating segments, or appetite shifts to leadership
  • Participate in audits and internal reviews to ensure compliance with underwriting standards

Broker Engagement

  • Maintain effective working relationships with wholesale brokers within the carrier’s distribution model
  • Communicate underwriting decisions clearly and professionally, including rationale for pricing, structure, or coverage changes
  • Provide guidance to brokers on risk characteristics, carrier appetite, and submission requirements
  • Represent the carrier at industry events, broker meetings, and training sessions as appropriate

Documentation & Compliance

  • Prepare clear, accurate underwriting files that document the basis for each binding decision
  • Ensure all transactions adhere to surplus lines regulatory requirements, internal policies, and delegated authority limits
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of underwriting guidelines, carrier appetite, and state-specific insurance laws
  • Stay current on legal developments and emerging excess casualty liability trends

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in excess casualty or surplus lines underwriting
  • Experience making binding underwriting decisions within a delegated authority framework
  • Strong technical knowledge of E&S casualty coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology
  • Ability to analyze complex risk submissions, loss data, and exposure information to reach sound underwriting conclusions
  • Solid understanding of surplus lines regulations and E&S market placement
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and defend underwriting decisions
  • Proficiency with underwriting platforms, rating tools, and productivity software

Preferred

  • Professional designations such as CPCU, ARM, or AU
  • Experience underwriting across multiple casualty classes including contracting, product liability, real estate, and institutional risks
  • Familiarity with actuarial pricing models and loss development concepts

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, risk management, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in excess casualty or surplus lines underwriting
  • Professional designations such as CPCU, ARM, or AU preferred

Job Title: Distinguished Engineer, Enterprise Solutions Engineering

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

CVS Health is seeking a Distinguished Engineer to join the Cloud Solution Engineering team and act as a senior technical leader across system architecture, enterprise engineering patterns, resiliency, and technology governance. This role will evaluate and shape end-to-end system designs so they align with CVS Health security, compliance, operational, and resiliency standards while also supporting business scalability and delivery outcomes. The engineer will partner closely with application teams, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, and Operations to review business requirements, logical architectures, network flows, platform dependencies, and solution implementation patterns.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead system design and architecture reviews for enterprise applications, platforms, and shared services.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable end-to-end system designs.
  • Evaluate logical architectures against CVS Health approved patterns for ingress, secure hub routing, managed firewall traversal, API gateway usage, identity, and private connectivity.
  • Guide engineering teams on approved hosting models across Kubernetes clusters, web applications, and shared cloud platforms.
  • Assess application architectures against resiliency tier expectations including RTO, RPO, replication, failover, AirGap backup, observability, and operational recovery readiness.
  • Validate use of approved cloud-native, managed, and SaaS services across Azure, GCP, AWS, and on-prem environments.
  • Provide architecture gap assessments, remediation plans, and target-state recommendations for application teams and engineering leadership.
  • Drive system engineering decisions across infrastructure, application, integration, data, network, identity, and observability domains.
  • Create and evolve reference architectures, reusable engineering blueprints, and architecture review frameworks for the Solution Engineering team.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, and platform teams on standards adoption, exception handling, and risk-based design decisions.
  • Mentor engineers and architects in strong system design, resiliency engineering, and enterprise solution pattern usage.
  • Support AI-enabled automation of architecture reviews using structured rules, multimodal inputs, and knowledge-based recommendations.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, system engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, or enterprise architecture.
  • Deep expertise in system design for large-scale enterprise applications, service-oriented systems, and distributed platforms.
  • Deep expertise in system engineering across infrastructure, networking, security, application, integration, and operations domains.
  • Strong experience designing and reviewing cloud-native and hybrid architectures across Azure, GCP, AWS, and/or on-prem environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security patterns including edge ingress, load balancing, API gateways, network segmentation, firewall controls, identity management and private service connectivity.
  • Strong knowledge of resiliency engineering, including high availability, disaster recovery, backup and restore, replication, failover, and operational recovery planning.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, web-hosted application platforms, APIs, managed data services, and service-to-service integration patterns.
  • Ability to evaluate ambiguous business and technical requirements, identify architectural risk, and provide clear engineering guidance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready architecture assessments and technical recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated enterprise environment.
  • Experience with enterprise identity and authorization patterns such as Azure AD or Entra ID, managed identity, service principals, OAuth 2.0, and external identity providers.
  • Experience with API management platforms such as Azure API Management, Apigee X, Kong, or comparable gateway technologies.
  • Experience with architecture governance, approved service catalogues, and cloud adoption guardrails.
  • Experience building or supporting AI-enabled engineering workflows, architecture assessment platforms, or recommendation automation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, and knowledge-driven advisory systems.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise workflow and documentation platforms.

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field.

Position: PV Design Engineer (Freelance, B2B Solar projects)
Location: Ukraine / EU countries, remote (UA-citizenship candidates only)

Ми маємо цікаву пропозицію для досвідченого Інженера-проектувальника СЕС в провідній українській компанії з галузі відновлюваної енергетики, який зацікавлений долучитися до співпраці на проєктній основі.

Наш Партнер має велике портфоліо реалізованих проєктів різної потужності та висококваліфіковану команду експертів, яка спеціалізується на наданні комплексних послуг з розрахунку, проектування, будівництва та подальшого обслуговування сонячних електростанцій для бізнесу, домогосподарств та громад. Компанія має власний інженерний, технічний, сервісний та інсталяційний підрозділ, що дає можливість контролювати якість процесу впровадження проєктів на всіх етапах реалізації.

З метою забезпечення реалізації динамічно зростаючого портфеля проєктів нашого Партнера ми знаходимось в пошуку Інженера-проектувальника, який зможе брати участь у всьому циклі проектування B2B СЕС проєктів компанії.

Основні обов'язки:

  • Підготовка ТЗ на проєктування
  • Підготовка ескізних проєктних рішень (розміщення обладнання, схеми, специфікація)
  • Розробка проектної документації для побудови СЕС: ПЗ, розміщення фотомодулів, планів прокладання ліній DС та АС, схеми підключення інверторів та АКБ, схеми автоматизації та синхронізації з ДЕС, кабельні журнали, специфікації обладнання та матеріалів
  • Розрахунок генерації
  • Погодження проєктів з представниками технічної служби замовника та/або з експертизою (за домовленістю)
  • Ведення авторського нагляду за реалізацією проєкту (за домовленістю)

Кваліфікація та професійний досвід:

  • Вища технічна освіта (бажано електротехнічна)
  • Досвід роботи інженером-проектувальником
  • Володіння ПЗ:
    - AutoCAD для створення 2D креслень (обов'язково)
    - PVSyst для формування звітів, зокрема з погодинної генерації (є перевагою)
    - SketchUp для прив'язки геолокації, формування затінень, створення анімації (є перевагою)
    - Плагін Skelion для розкладання фотомодулів, розрахунку генерації, створення моделей власних ФЕМ (є перевагою)
  • Знання вимог Правил улаштування електроустановок (ПУЕ)
  • Знання вимог до оформлення проектної документації згідно ДБН
  • Розрахунок втрат напруги та підбір перерізу кабелів
  • Знання типів кріплень ФЕМ до покрівлі (розуміння вузлів)
  • Знання схем релейного управління (АВР, реле запуску генератора, перемикання ліній як автоматично, так і за допомогою перемикачів)
  • Знання організації ліній зв'язку між інверторами, смартлогерами, лічильниками, трансформаторами струму
  • Досвід роботи з різними типами сонячного обладнання: знання складових СЕС, вимог та стандартів, щодо їх встановлення, підключення та експлуатації

Є додатковою перевагою:

  • Наявність сертифіката проектувальника СС1-СС3
  • Наявність сертифікатів від виробників обладнання про знайомство з характеристиками їх обладнання
  • Знання англійської мови (для ознайомлення з технічною документацією)

Якщо Ви є досвідченим Інженером-проектувальником у галузі сонячної енергетики та відкриті до гнучкої проєктної співпраці, будь ласка, надішліть своє резюме на з темою листа "PV Design Engineer (Freelance, UA)", та ми надамо Вам більш детальну інформацію про цю пропозицію.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Software Quality Operations (SWQOps) team is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.

Why This Team is Essential to Waymo's Success:

Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026) and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQOps, especially our Technical Specialists, plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently.

We are on the front lines of:

  • Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. A successful flywheel will be the core engine for scaling our technology, enabling faster ODD expansion, quicker remediation of driving issues, and a significant reduction in the engineering effort required to maintain and improve the driver
  • De-risking New Deployments: Through meticulous triage of driving events, issue discovery, and continuous field monitoring, SWQOps provides early warnings and critical insights. This "early intervention in RO issue detection" ensures operational resilience and safety, particularly in new and complex environments, which is critical as Waymo enters multiple new cities and ramps up platforms like W12
  • Enabling Market Expansion: Our team is deeply integrated into every stage of Waymo's market entry framework, from initial city evaluation (OK2Plan) to scaling operations (OK2Scale). We provide the necessary data analysis, policy development, and quality assurance to unblock critical milestones, preventing slowdowns in market expansion velocity
  • Driving Engineering Velocity: By handling the vital work of performance evaluation, issue deep-dives, and data set curation, SWQOps collaborates heavily and allows Waymo's Engineering, SysEng, Simulation, and Data Science teams to focus on their core tasks of developing and improving the Waymo Driver

You will:

  • Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. Develop and refine data-driven strategies for issue discovery and monitoring, enhanced by ML model outputs
  • Serve as the key link between AI/ML development and operational execution. Define and document new policies, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that integrate AI tools and insights into daily vendor workflows.
  • Design and implement robust quality control processes for both human and AI-generated outputs. Perform meta-quality checks, validate the integrity of vendor work, and provide feedback to improve both human and model performance
  • Act as the subject matter expert for our Software Quality Operations, working closely with stakeholders, program leads, and vendor teams to ensure seamless adoption and maximum impact of AI/ML advancements in our quality processes. Be the trusted source for creating and updating technical policies, guidelines, and standard operating procedures for new scopes, platforms, and driving signals
  • Provide technical leadership and consultation to stakeholders to enhance our workflows and quality. You'll be at the forefront of identifying and escalating issues with our tools, providing technical requirements to engineering, and driving user testing to support the development and deployment of new tooling features
  • Scale workflow from 16/5 to 24/7 coordinating with external stakeholders, vendor team, and FTE team

You have:

  • BS/BA degree and 4 years of relevant work experience in QC or AV Software Quality Operations
  • Increased competency in supporting all phases of the machine learning development life-cycle: data preparation, training, validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring
  • Experience with ML testing and validation, including dataset quality assurance, bias detection, edge-case scenario testing, and performance evaluation using statistical metrics
  • Ability to quickly learn and implement new concepts and utilize proprietary tools. Strong understanding of driving rules and regulations
  • A proven ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining good judgment
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with a wide range of individuals in a diverse and dynamic work environment
  • Demonstrated strong execution with ability to drive outcomes
  • Ability to effectively and efficiently communicate with cross-functional stakeholders

We prefer:

  • Experience assessing AV safety performance

  • Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
  • Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

SafeLease is looking for a driven Senior Full Stack Software Engineer. In this role, you’ll work across the entire stack building, testing, and shipping features. You'll collaborate closely with company leadership, playing a key role in solving high-impact technical challenges and shaping the future of our platform.

About The Role

Joining our Engineering team at this stage means your work will have a huge influence on future developers, the codebase, and company culture. This role is based out of our downtown Austin office—full time at first and then hybrid after onboarding.

To drive our mission forward, this role will:

  • Lead development across the stack — Architect, build, and ship high-quality code across our entire platform, setting the standard for technical excellence

  • Design scalable, elegant solutions — Collaborate with Product to solve complex problems with simple, customer-centric features

  • Own issue resolution — Triage, prioritize, and resolve system level issues while guiding others on best practices for quality and reliability

  • Champion continuous improvement — Proactively identify opportunities to improve system performance, code health, and team efficiency

  • Advocate for the user — Build with empathy and a deep understanding of customer needs, ensuring every solution adds meaningful value

  • Mentor and elevate others — Share expertise, coach teammates, and help shape a culture of learning, growth, and technical rigor

About You

A collaborative and innovative thinker who has experience shipping code in a fast-paced, agile environment will make a huge impact at SafeLease!

Your experience:

  • 5+ years in a full-stack software development role with a track record of owning and delivering complex features or systems

  • Degree in CS/EE

  • Deep proficiency with Frontend (TypeScript, JavaScript, React), Backend (Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs), and Infrastructure (Relational databases, Git, AWS) systems and languages

  • Ability to learn and adapt to best-in-class tools including but not limited to Linear, Cursor, and other rapidly advancing AI tools

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to lead discussions, drive alignment, and mentor peers

  • DevOps-related experience is a plus—skills that go beyond just writing code and own how that code runs in production

  • Desire to work in-person or hybrid from our beautiful downtown Austin office

Why SafeLease?

The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.

The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.

The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.


If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

The Touro University Graduate School of Social Work is seeking candidates for a full-time (10-month appointment), online, Assistant/Associate Professor in Social Work. The successful candidate must have demonstrated capability to teach in multiple modalities including synchronous (Zoom), and asynchronous online formats. Successful candidates will exhibit a commitment to excellence in teaching, mentoring, instructional design, and engaged scholarship. Experience should include curriculum development, education best practices, instruction/teaching in social work, student advising, ability to engage students both in and out of the classroom. Ideal candidates will have a defined area of research and scholarship and a social work practice area of expertise. Associate-level candidates are expected to demonstrate a sustained record of publications or contributions to an area of expertise. Demonstrated experience with CSWE Accreditation Standards is a plus. A typical workday will entail teaching, advising, and meetings. Faculty carry a 21-credit workload per academic year, with responsibilities distributed across teaching, scholarship, and service. Faculty participate in MSW program activities as needed (orientation, community days, committee meetings, and curriculum development), and will also contribute on departmental and university-wide committees.

The mission of the Touro University Graduate School of Social Work is to educate graduates for clinical social work practice in an urban, and multicultural environment. This is consistent with the general mission of Touro University, which is to provide professional education for the benefit of the individual and society. This general mission is an expression of the Jewish religious tenet of Tikkun Olam, the striving to make the world a better place for all people. In accordance with traditional social work values, the Graduate School of Social Work is committed to providing accessible and affordable quality education to all. The MSW program's educational purpose is to prepare self-reflective professionals who can meet the complex needs of a multitude of populations. The school's curriculum is informed by the person-in-environment, ecological and strengths-based perspectives. The school provides students with a social work education that offers a theoretical and evidence-based foundation in generalist social work, as well as advanced knowledge and skills for effective clinical social work. You own a portfolio of Kyra's largest enterprise accounts (multi-million-dollar brand partnerships) and you're measured on whether they grow. Retention, expansion, and Net Revenue Retention are your scoreboard.

This is a commercial role, not a delivery one. You keep enterprise clients, grow them, and run delivery cleanly enough that growth is never at risk.

  • Revenue. You carry an NRR target across your book. You protect it, and you grow it.

  • The relationship. You're the trusted strategic partner to senior brand-side stakeholders, not the campaign contact.

  • The system. You're the connective tissue between Sales, Strategy, Campaigns, Paid, and Product, and you keep them aligned and operating efficiently.

Own client relationships across launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programs. Multi-thread across teams. Build trust. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

📈 Turn Insight into Strategy

Translate data into clear, actionable plans. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

You'll be expected to use AI daily to compress reporting, model renewals, prep upsells, and synthesise client data, so you can buy back time for the things that add value, like managing the relationship.

🔍 Own Delivery End-to-End

Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across seeding, paid, and integrated campaigns. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

📊 Protect & Grow Revenue

Manage renewal timelines. Identify upsell opportunities. Drive Net Revenue Retention. Be able to speak confidently about account growth with real numbers.

💾 Use Data to Improve What's Next

Forecast performance. Optimise mid-campaign. Apply learnings to the next program. Reporting informs decisions; it's not a recap.

Keep tracking clean. Watch team capacity. Fix what's inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn't get lost.

Curious. Commercially aware. Direct. Adaptable. Strong at building trust. Open to feedback. You don't avoid hard conversations. You don't wait for issues to escalate. You don't need constant direction.

6 months in: renewals are planned early, NRR targets are on track, expansion opportunities are clearly mapped, delivery runs smoothly, and leadership trusts your forecast.

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Senior Credit Manager, US Card

Tilt is looking for a Senior Credit Manager to join our Card Customer Management team, focused on Line Management. Our existing line increase programs are healthy, but there's significant untapped opportunity beyond them: recovering spend, unlocking underutilized usage, and building the next generation of line management programs. This role exists to find and build that opportunity.

You'll work at the intersection of credit policy, quantitative analysis, and program design, partnering closely with Data Science and Product while independently owning the analytical work behind new program ideas — from identifying the opportunity, to designing and testing a policy, to scaling what works. This is an individual-contributor role with outsized visibility: you won't manage a team, but you will regularly partner with and influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who wants deep ownership of high-impact analytical work and who's energized by taking a loosely-defined problem space and independently driving it to a tested, scalable solution — without waiting to be told what to build.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Ideate and build new line management programs: Independently identify, design, and test new programs and policies that complement our existing line management programs — for example, over-limit policies, dynamic or instant line increases, or incentive-based credit line increases.

  • Own the analytical work end-to-end: Run your own SQL- and/or Python-based analysis to size opportunities, structure tests, and evaluate results, turning insights into a roadmap you build in partnership with Data Science and Product.

  • Partner closely with Data Science: Identify opportunities where a new or enhanced risk models would outperform the existing approach, then partner with DS to define success criteria and serve as the business owner driving that model forward.

  • Drive through ambiguity with urgency: Take undefined, loosely-scoped problem spaces and independently turn them into concrete, tested programs — scoping the approach, building the test, and pushing it through to a result using your own judgment, without needing to be directed step by step.

  • Communicate with precision and influence: Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior stakeholders, and build the credibility to shape decisions without formal authority.


Why You're a Great Fit

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Business, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or similar); advanced degree a plus.

  • 5-7 years of experience in credit risk, data analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, ideally in consumer lending or fintech.

  • Strong SQL or Python skills — you're comfortable running your own queries independently, and you're able to pair that effectively with AI tools to execute on analysis

  • Excellent communication skills — able to go deep in the analytical weeds and also distill findings clearly for an executive audience.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and build trust with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners without formal reporting authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts, with comfort operating in ambiguity and a track record of driving projects forward independently.

  • A creative, action-oriented approach — someone who prototypes, tests, and iterates rather than waiting for a fully-defined problem statement.

  • Eagerness to learn new tools and methods, and to stay current with trends in credit, lending, and AI.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Atlys is changing that.

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers across South & Southeast Asia.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

  • Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

  • An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Idaho to identify experienced finance and revenue cycle leaders who understand the unique realities of rural healthcare.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming finance, accounting, reimbursement, revenue cycle, billing, coding, and patient financial services leadership opportunities across Idaho.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, rural and community hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

Strong financial and revenue cycle operations help protect healthcare access for an entire rural community.

These leaders ensure organizations can accurately capture revenue, manage resources responsibly, support employees, maintain compliance, and remain financially strong enough to continue caring for the people who depend on them.

In a rural healthcare organization, finance and revenue cycle leaders often work across departments and may have broader responsibilities than they would in a larger system. The strongest leaders understand how registration, coding, billing, reimbursement, patient accounts, accounting, and operational decisions connect to one another.

They are collaborative, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to turn complex financial information into practical guidance for employees, department leaders, executives, and governing boards.

Accounting Manager

Snapshot of Curvion Blue

Curvion Blue is a high-performance RevOps and sales augmentation company that helps businesses build and operate better revenue engines. Behind every strong revenue operation is strong financial visibility, and that’s where our accounting team comes in.

We work with multiple businesses and clients, which means our accounting team operates in a multi-company environment. Our Accounting Managers aren't responsible for just one set of books, one leadership team, or one monthly close. They are managing multiple clients, priorities, deadlines, accounting systems, and stakeholders at the same time.

That environment requires more than strong accounting fundamentals. It requires organization, judgment, communication, ownership, and the ability to keep a lot of moving pieces moving in the right direction.

Position Overview

We’re looking for an Accounting Manager who can own the accounting function across multiple assigned clients while leading and developing Staff Accountants.

This is a hands-on accounting leadership role. You’ll oversee day-to-day accounting activity, review Staff Accountant work, manage month-end close, review financial statements, maintain accounting controls, identify issues, and work closely with Controllers to ensure they have accurate and reliable financial information.

Experience managing accounting for multiple companies at once is extremely important for this role.

The ideal candidate has worked in a fractional accounting, outsourced accounting, public accounting, CAS, accounting firm, or similar multi-client environment where managing several sets of books simultaneously was part of the normal workflow.

You should be comfortable jumping between different businesses, accounting systems, stakeholders, deadlines, and financial situations without losing the plot.

Basically: if you like one set of books, one close calendar, and one predictable workflow, this probably isn't your dream job.

You SHOULD Apply If

  • You have experience managing accounting for multiple companies or clients simultaneously

  • You have worked in a fractional, outsourced, public accounting, CAS, accounting firm, or agency environment

  • You have strong full-cycle accounting experience and understand GAAP-based accrual accounting

  • You have experience owning or managing month-end close

  • You have experience reviewing the work of Staff Accountants, Bookkeepers, or other accounting professionals

  • You can manage competing deadlines across multiple businesses without needing someone to constantly tell you what to do next

  • You are highly organized and naturally keep track of outstanding items, deadlines, and follow-ups

  • You are comfortable communicating with Controllers, leadership, clients, and accounting team members

  • You can identify accounting issues before they become bigger problems

  • You enjoy coaching and developing accounting professionals

  • You naturally look for ways to improve processes rather than accepting "that's how we've always done it"

  • You are comfortable working in multiple accounting systems and learning new tools quickly

  • You take ownership when something goes wrong and focus on solving the problem rather than assigning blame

You SHOULD NOT Apply If

  • Your experience has been exclusively within a single company's accounting department and you've never managed multiple companies or clients at once

  • You need a highly predictable workload with one set of books and one consistent workflow

  • You prefer purely transactional accounting and don't enjoy reviewing or developing other accountants

  • You struggle to prioritize when multiple deadlines compete for your attention

  • You tend to wait for someone else to identify accounting issues before addressing them

  • You aren't comfortable communicating directly with Controllers, leadership, or clients

  • You don't enjoy process improvement or building better ways of doing things

  • You need significant oversight to stay organized and manage your workload

What You'll Own

Client Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Own the accounting function for assigned client accounts

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely financial records

  • Perform and oversee full-cycle accounting processes

  • Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by Staff Accountants

  • Review and approve journal entries prepared by Staff Accountants

  • Perform P&L scrubs and balance sheet reviews

  • Ensure financial statements and supporting information are accurate and complete

  • Review financial notes and financial packages

  • Ensure KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes align with the underlying financial information

  • Identify discrepancies, accounting issues, and potential risks and communicate them promptly to the Controller

  • Maintain confidentiality of client financial information

Month-End Close

  • Own the month-end close timeline and checklist for assigned clients

  • Review Staff Accountant work throughout the close process

  • Complete required technical QA through the Month-End Workbook

  • Ensure accuracy of balance sheet workbooks

  • Perform source document filing spot checks

  • Review the final P&L scrub

  • Review and approve journal entries

  • Review and finalize financial statements and supporting schedules

  • Ensure financial information is ready for Controller review

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Staff Accountants

  • Review Staff Accountant work and provide meaningful technical feedback

  • Help Staff Accountants strengthen their technical accounting skills

  • Prepare team members for expanded responsibilities

  • Own performance management for direct reports, including coaching, corrective action, documentation, and escalation when necessary

  • Create an environment where team members can raise professional challenges and ask for help

  • Participate in semiannual performance reviews

  • Participate in weekly team meetings and drive follow-through on action items

  • Maintain clear communication with the accounting team, particularly during month-end

Weekly Accounting Responsibilities

  • Review customer invoicing

  • Review vendor bills and submit payments

  • Approve and submit payroll

  • Perform P&L scrubs

  • Review cash flow forecasts

  • Resolve collections issues

  • Manage recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

  • Monitor outstanding accounting items and follow up as needed

  • Communicate progress, risks, and issues proactively

Compliance & Tax

Quarterly

  • Complete 941 reconciliations

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

  • Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s

  • Review the chart of accounts

  • Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

  • Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

Systems, Processes & Controls

  • Develop, improve, maintain, and document full-cycle accounting processes

  • Set up and sync accounting programs and tools

  • Review third-party applications for accuracy and proper mapping

  • Maintain accounting controls and procedures

  • Monitor for potential fraud and escalate concerns immediately

  • Review accounting processes and procedural documentation

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, cost savings, and profitability

  • Recommend process improvements to Controllers and leadership

Communication & Client Management

  • Maintain consistent communication with Controllers, client stakeholders, and the accounting team

  • Communicate effectively through Slack, email, text, meetings, and other appropriate channels

  • Tailor communication to different audiences

  • Respond to communications within one business day, even when the complete answer is still in progress

  • Proactively communicate issues, delays, risks, and outstanding items

  • Provide regular updates on client accounting activity and priorities

  • Keep stakeholders informed rather than waiting to be asked for updates

What Success Looks Like

You Own Your Clients

Controllers and stakeholders know they can trust you to stay on top of the accounting for your assigned clients. You know what is happening, what's outstanding, what's coming next, and where there may be a problem.

The Books Are Right

Financial statements are accurate, complete, and properly supported. You don't simply approve the work that comes across your desk. You understand it well enough to catch inconsistencies, ask the right questions, and make sure the numbers tell the right story.

Month-End Doesn't Become Month-End Mayhem

You manage the close process proactively. Deadlines are clear, Staff Accountants know what needs to happen, issues are escalated early, and Controllers aren't finding surprises at the end of the process.

Your Staff Accountants Get Better

You aren't just reviewing work. You're developing people. Your Staff Accountants become more technically capable, more independent, and better equipped to take on additional responsibility.

Multiple Clients Don't Break Your Brain

You can move between multiple companies, accounting systems, priorities, and stakeholders while maintaining organization and attention to detail.

This is one of the biggest differentiators for this role.

We aren't looking for someone who can manage one company's accounting really well. We're looking for someone who can manage multiple companies really well.

You Improve the Machine

You identify repetitive problems, inefficient processes, and opportunities for improvement. You don't just work within the system. You help make the system better.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience

  • Strong full-cycle accounting experience

  • Strong understanding of GAAP and accrual accounting

  • Experience with month-end close and financial statement preparation

  • Experience reviewing accounting work completed by others

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently

Highly Preferred

Experience managing multiple companies or clients simultaneously.

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Fractional accounting

  • Outsourced accounting

  • Public accounting

  • Client Accounting Services (CAS)

  • Accounting firms

  • Bookkeeping or accounting agencies

  • Fractional CFO/accounting firms

  • Multi-entity accounting environments

  • Managing accounting for multiple small and mid-sized businesses

If you've had 5, 10, or 20 sets of books on your plate at the same time, we want to hear about it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with multiple accounting platforms

  • Experience with QuickBooks Online and other cloud-based accounting systems

  • Experience managing and developing Staff Accountants

  • Experience working directly with Controllers or CFOs

  • Experience building or improving accounting SOPs

  • Experience with accounting automation and integrations

  • Experience in a high-growth or rapidly changing environment

  • Experience supporting clients across different industries

The Person We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is technically strong, highly organized, and comfortable owning a lot of moving pieces at once.

You're the person who can look at a portfolio of clients and immediately know what needs attention, what can wait, and what absolutely cannot fall through the cracks.

You don't need to be chased down for updates. You don't wait until month-end to discover a problem that could have been caught two weeks ago. And when a Staff Accountant makes a mistake, your response isn't just to fix it. You figure out why it happened and how to prevent it from happening again.

Most importantly, you're comfortable operating in a multi-client environment.

Because around here, you're not managing one company's accounting.

You're managing accounting for multiple businesses, while helping the people around you get better at their jobs.

That's the job.

Hours: Monday-Friday 9am-6pm US Time Zones

You want a role where you own the company’s most important technical initiative, not one where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.

  • Identify, evaluate, and replace legacy dependencies that don’t have a path forward to modern .NET, without introducing functional or performance regressions
  • Make the technical sequencing calls: which areas migrate first, which dependencies get replaced when, and where automated conversion is viable vs. manual rewrite
  • Lay the foundation for the team to grow by modernizing the stack to one that any C# developer can contribute to

jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, programmable data centre infrastructure using software-defined networking principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.

What You'll Do

Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:

1. State orientation

2. Open standards-based approach

3. Single software image consistency

1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication

State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network. This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.

2) An Open Approach

Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original OS kernel is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source Linux, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.

3) A Single Image

Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers. The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations. This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

  • Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills.
  • 5+ Fluency in one of C or C++ programming.
  • Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share, and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.

To do this, we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6000 citations in scientific papers and over 60000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories, analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes.

Saphetor is a Swiss precision medicine company with offices in Lausanne (CH), Boston (USA), and Athens (GR) employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a C++ Developer to join our backend team. If you're driven by clean code, cross team collaboration and excited to work in the fast moving world of genomics, this is a place where your work will matter.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Code Craftsmanship: Write reusable, testable, and efficient code — backed by thorough unit and regression tests that keep the platform reliable as it evolves.
  • Core Engineering: Develop our core C++ applications and library for importing and analyzing genetic data.
  • Project Ownership: Take complete ownership of projects ranging from a few days to a month, delivering working end-to-end implementations from design through testing and deployment.
  • Performance & Scale: Assist in the optimization and architecture of our platform for maximum speed, high availability, and scalability — pushing the limits of what's possible with large-scale genomic data.
  • Annotation Tooling: Maintain and improve our internal high-performance clinical annotation tools and the custom databases purpose-built and optimized for genetics workloads.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to clear, lasting documentation of software architecture and implementation details so the team can build on.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with backend engineers, bioinformaticians, and product stakeholders to scope work, align on interfaces, and deliver cohesive end-to-end features.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate is a C++ Developer with hands-on experience writing modern C++. You write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable engaging in code reviews and cross-functional work with other stakeholders.

What you will bring:

  • Academic Foundation: BS or MS degree in Computer Science.
  • C++ Expertise: At least 3 years of professional experience as a back-end developer working with C++ (preferably with C++ 17 or later), templates, STL containers, smart pointers, memory management and multithreading.
  • Database Skills: Hands-on experience with relational databases, including optimizing queries and table schemas for peak performance.
  • Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed cloud-based computing and big-data systems.
  • Design Principles: Good grasp of fundamental application design and object-oriented principles, essential for building and maintaining a large, high-quality codebase.
  • Active Engagement: Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Team Player: Flexible mindset, comfortable stepping into a variety of roles as needed.

Strongly Valued:

  • In-Memory & RPC Tech: Experience with in-memory databases like Redis and gRPC services.
  • Domain Interest: Some bioinformatics background — or a genuine willingness to dive into the domain.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote-first work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

Senior Azure Integration Engineer

Enterprise Azure Integration Services Profile

Senior Azure Integration Engineer with 7-10+ years of hands-on enterprise integration experience across Microsoft Azure Integration Services, secure API platforms, event-driven architecture, and reliable system-to-system integration. Experienced with Azure API Management, Logic Apps Standard, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid/Event Hubs, Key Vault, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Azure DevOps/GitHub, and Infrastructure as Code. Strong background building secure, supportable, and repeatable integrations across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Fabric/Data Factory, SaaS platforms, core systems, partner APIs, and enterprise line-of-business applications.

Core AIS expertise

  • Azure API Management (APIM): enterprise API gateway design, products/subscriptions, policies, OAuth2/JWT validation, managed identities, Key Vault-backed named values, throttling/rate limiting, IP filtering, versions/revisions, developer portal, and API lifecycle management.
  • Logic Apps Standard and Azure Functions: workflow orchestration, connector-based integration, C#/.NET serverless development, HTTP/timer/Service Bus triggers, VNET-integrated hosting, managed identity access, and Application Insights telemetry.
  • Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs: reliable messaging, pub/sub, queues, topics/subscriptions, filters, sessions, load leveling, event routing, and scalable event-driven processing.
  • Batch and data movement patterns using Data Factory / Fabric Data Factory pipelines for scheduled processing, enrichment, bulk movement, and incremental integration scenarios.

Enterprise integration patterns

  • Design and implementation of synchronous API, asynchronous messaging, event-driven, and batch/data-movement integration patterns.
  • Layered API architecture using Experience APIs, Process/Orchestration APIs, and System APIs to reduce point-to-point coupling and isolate backend change.
  • Resilient processing patterns including retries, dead-letter queues, idempotency, duplicate detection, message sessions, sequencing, correlation IDs, replay/reprocessing, and operational error handling.
  • Integration with Microsoft business applications and enterprise platforms, including Dynamics 365 / Dataverse, Finance & Operations, Fabric/Data Factory, SaaS platforms, partner APIs, and custom .NET services.

Security, networking, and governance

  • Secure Azure integration platform design using VNET integration, internal/private APIM patterns, Application Gateway/WAF, private endpoints, private DNS, NSGs, and restricted backend access.
  • Identity and access patterns using Entra ID, OAuth2/JWT, managed identities, app registrations, least-privilege RBAC, and secure system-to-system authentication.
  • Secrets and configuration management using Azure Key Vault, managed identity access, APIM named values, certificates, keys, and governed access controls.
  • Enterprise governance practices including naming conventions, tagging, environment separation, RBAC, branch policies, release approvals, and auditability.

DevOps, IaC, and operational excellence

  • Azure DevOps and GitHub-based CI/CD using YAML pipelines, environment promotion, approvals, branch strategies, and repeatable deployment models across Dev/UAT/Prod.
  • Infrastructure as Code with Bicep and/or Terraform for AIS resources, networking, Key Vault, Service Bus, APIM, Function Apps, Logic Apps, diagnostics, and shared platform components.
  • API Ops / APIM automation patterns for extracting, version-controlling, validating, and promoting API definitions and policies across environments.
  • Observability using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, APIM diagnostics, distributed tracing, correlation IDs, dashboards, alerts, and support-oriented failure analysis.

Architecture and delivery experience

  • Produces and reviews Integration Design Documents, mapping specifications, sequence/data-flow diagrams, assumptions, constraints, test scenarios, and support handover documentation.
  • Participates in discovery workshops, mapping reviews, architecture reviews, technical design sessions, KT sessions, and client-facing discussions around scope, dependencies, risks, and implementation approach.
  • Works across architects, developers, data engineers, security, networking, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise-grade integration solutions.
  • Collaborative and agile delivery style; able to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and supportable technical implementation patterns.

Preferred / desired qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification preferred or desired.
  • Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa transfer requirement.
  • Enterprise consulting, integration modernization, or legacy middleware replacement experience is strongly beneficial.
